definition_en: related by adoption rather than by birth, or describing a country or place someone has chosen to live in
core_image: 相册里一张合影，孩子坐在两位大人中间，笑得很自然
scene: 他在异国住了三十年，早把那里当成自己的家。 He calls Canada his adoptive country.

senses.title: Related through adoption
senses.definition: describing a parent, child or family joined by adoption rather than by birth
senses.definitionCN: 指通过收养而非血缘建立关系的父母、子女或家庭
senses.example: His adoptive parents moved to Spain when he was six.
senses.exampleCN: 他六岁时，养父母搬到了西班牙。
senses.why: The adjective keeps the -ive ending of a describing word and marks the side that does the adopting, as opposed to the child, who is adopted.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词保留 -ive 词尾，标记「实施收养」的那一方，与「被收养」的孩子相对。

senses.title: Chosen as one's country or home
senses.definition: describing a place that someone has chosen to live in and come to regard as home
senses.definitionCN: 指某人选择定居并认作故乡的地方
senses.example: The writer made Paris his adoptive home.
senses.exampleCN: 这位作家把巴黎当作自己的第二故乡。
senses.why: A country can be chosen the way a child is: it is taken into one's life and called one's own.
senses.whyCN: 国家也可以像孩子一样被「选择」：它被接进一个人的生活，并被称为自己的。

intro.en: An adjective of choosing, applied to people and to places.
intro.cn: 一个表示「选择」的形容词，用在人身上，也用在地方上。

items.en: Travel and migration extended it to countries and cities that people choose as home.

definition_zh: 水循环；水在海洋、大气与陆地之间蒸发、凝结、降水、径流并回归的往复过程
definition_en: the continuous circulation of water between ocean, atmosphere and land through evaporation, condensation, precipitation and runoff
core_image: 一滴水从海面被太阳抬上天空，凝成云，落回山脊，顺河归海，再被抬起，画出一个闭合的圈
scene: 地理课的玻璃箱里，灯照着水面，水汽升到顶盖凝成细珠，随后一滴滴落回箱底。 In the classroom tank, the water cycle repeats as vapour rises, condenses on the lid and falls back.
sceneCN: 这里 water cycle 指「水在海洋、大气与陆地之间往复的完整回路」（第 1 个义项：以蒸发、凝结、降水与径流为环节的闭环过程）；句意为课堂演示箱中水汽上升、在顶盖凝结、又落回原处，这一回路反复出现。可辨识物件：玻璃箱、台灯、水面、顶盖雾珠、下落水滴。

pos.zh: 水循环；水文循环（不可数，指自然界水的往复过程）

forms.label: 通常形式（不可数，指过程）
复数（指多个回路或多次循环）

derivatives.zh: 水循环的（作定语，如 water-cycle model）

senses.title: Evaporation lifts water
senses.titleCN: 蒸发：水离开水面升入空中
senses.definition: the step in which surface water changes into vapour and rises into the air
senses.definitionCN: 表层水变成水汽并升入空中的环节
senses.example: Sunlight on the lake drives evaporation, the first step of the cycle.
senses.exampleCN: 阳光照在湖面上促成蒸发，这是循环的第一步。
senses.why: The loop has to start somewhere, and it starts at the boundary between liquid and air, where heat gives molecules enough energy to escape the surface.
senses.whyCN: 这个回路总要有一个起点，而起点就在水与大气的交界处：热量给了水分子足够的能量，让它们脱离水面。

senses.title: Condensation builds cloud
senses.titleCN: 凝结：水汽在冷空气中聚成云
senses.definition: the step in which rising vapour cools and turns into tiny droplets that form clouds
senses.definitionCN: 上升的水汽遇冷变成微小水滴并聚成云的环节
senses.example: The vapour cools as it rises, and condensation turns it into cloud.
senses.exampleCN: 水汽上升时冷却，凝结作用把它变成云。
senses.why: What goes up must cool: air expands with height, loses heat, and can no longer hold the same amount of vapour, so the excess returns to droplets.
senses.whyCN: 上升的东西必然变冷：空气随高度膨胀、失热，再也容纳不下同样多的水汽，多出的部分就重新变回小水滴。

senses.title: Precipitation returns water
senses.titleCN: 降水：云中的水重新落回地面
senses.definition: the step in which droplets grow heavy enough to fall as rain, snow or hail
senses.definitionCN: 水滴增大到足够重时以雨、雪或冰雹落回地面的环节
senses.example: Precipitation over the mountains feeds every stream below.
senses.exampleCN: 山上的降水补给山下的每一条溪流。
senses.why: A cloud is only a temporary holding place; once droplets merge and grow, gravity takes over and the water leaves the air.
senses.whyCN: 云只是暂时的存放处；一旦水滴合并变大，重力接管，水就离开大气落下来。

senses.title: Runoff and rivers
senses.titleCN: 径流：水沿地表汇入河流
senses.definition: the step in which water flows over the land surface into streams and rivers and back toward the sea
senses.definitionCN: 水沿陆地表层流入溪流、河流并归海的环节
senses.example: Runoff carries the storm water down to the river within hours.
senses.exampleCN: 径流在几小时内就把暴雨的水送到河里。
senses.why: Falling water seeks the lowest path. The land slopes, so the same water that fell on the ridge is delivered to the sea by gravity, not by pumps.
senses.whyCN: 落下的水会寻找最低处。地面有坡度，于是落在山脊上的水靠重力而非水泵被送到海里。

senses.title: Infiltration into the ground
senses.titleCN: 下渗：水渗入土壤与岩层
senses.definition: the step in which part of the water sinks into soil and rock instead of running off
senses.definitionCN: 部分水不流走而渗入土壤与岩石的环节
senses.example: Sandy soil allows deep infiltration, so less water reaches the stream.
senses.exampleCN: 沙质土壤下渗很深，因此到达溪流的水更少。
senses.why: The loop has two return roads: the surface road and the underground road. Infiltration is where the water chooses the second one.
senses.whyCN: 这个回路有两条归路：地表之路与地下之路。下渗就是水选择第二条路的地方。

senses.title: A balanced budget
senses.titleCN: 水量平衡：收入与支出相抵
senses.definition: the accounting view in which precipitation equals evaporation, runoff and storage change combined
senses.definitionCN: 把降水与蒸发、径流和蓄量变化相加后相抵的核算视角
senses.example: Over a year, the basin's water cycle must balance its inputs and outputs.
senses.exampleCN: 一年之内，流域的水循环必须让输入与输出相抵。
senses.why: Because the loop is closed, nothing can be added or lost overall; every drop that arrives must be accounted for somewhere.
senses.whyCN: 因为回路是闭合的，总体上既不能增加也不能丢失；每一滴到来的水都必须在某处被记账。

senses.title: The textbook diagram
senses.titleCN: 教材模型：带箭头的示意图
senses.definition: the simplified teaching model with labelled arrows showing each transfer
senses.definitionCN: 用带标注的箭头显示每一段转移的简化教学模型
senses.example: The exam asked students to label the water cycle from memory.
senses.exampleCN: 考试要求学生凭记忆给水循环图标注。
senses.why: A real cycle is invisible and planetary in scale, so teaching replaces it with a small set of arrows that can be drawn on one page.
senses.whyCN: 真实的水循环看不见，而且有行星尺度，所以教学用一个能画在一页纸上的箭头集合来代替它。

senses.title: Abstract: any repeated circulation
senses.definition: any resource or influence that keeps returning through the same set of stages
senses.definitionCN: 任何沿同一组环节不断返回的资源或影响
senses.example: Fashion runs on its own water cycle of revival and decay.
senses.exampleCN: 时尚有它自己的一套兴衰流转。
senses.why: Once a closed loop of stages is named after water, the name can be lent to money, ideas or styles that also come back around.
senses.whyCN: 一旦一套闭合的环节以水命名，这个名字就可以借给同样会绕回来的金钱、观念或风格。

intro.en: Water is a native Old English word; cycle came from Greek through Latin. The compound is an English scientific description, not a borrowed phrase. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: water 是古英语本族词；cycle 经拉丁语来自希腊语。这个复合词是英语的科学描述，不是借来的短语。年代为约数。

items.en: Old English wæter 'water' continues Proto-Germanic *watōr, and Greek hydōr 'water' is a cognate from the same Indo-European root.
items.cn: 古英语 wæter「水」延续原始日耳曼语 *watōr，希腊语 hydōr「水」同出这一印欧词根。

items.en: Greek kyklos meant circle, wheel or turning; Latin borrowed it as cyclus, and English took the Latin form in the fourteenth century with the sense of a recurring round.
items.cn: 希腊语 kyklos 指圆圈、车轮或转动；拉丁语借作 cyclus，英语在十四世纪引入这一拉丁形式，义为反复的一轮。

items.en: Natural philosophers of the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries described water as circulating between sea, air and land, and the two-word label followed from that description.
items.cn: 十七、十八世纪的自然哲学家用「循环」描述水在海、气、陆之间的往复，这个双词名称就由此而来。

items.en: The technical synonyms hydrologic cycle and hydrological cycle were built later from Greek hydōr plus logos, and both remain standard in hydrology.
items.cn: 技术同义词 hydrologic cycle 与 hydrological cycle 后来由希腊语 hydōr 加 logos 构成，两者至今都是水文学的标准说法。

items.en: Source uncertain (first attestation and root shape): no dictionary fixes the first written use of the exact phrase water cycle; the Indo-European root is a reconstruction usually written *wed-, and the competing form *wod- is another reconstruction, not a proven variant.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代与词根形态）：没有辞书能确定 water cycle 这一确切短语的首次书面使用；其印欧词根属重构形式，通常写作 *wed-，另有 *wod- 一说，同样只是重构，并非已证实的变体。

note.en: The first group holds phrases that name neighbouring parts of the same system; the second group holds terms that are close in meaning but are not the whole loop.
note.cn: 第一组是命名同一系统中相邻环节的短语；第二组是意思相近但并不等于整个回路的术语。

entries.definition: The same loop named from the science of hydrology rather than from the substance water.
entries.definitionCN: 同一个回路，只是从水文学科而不是从水本身命名。

entries.definition: The balance sheet of inputs and outputs within the cycle, not the cycle itself.
entries.definitionCN: 循环内部的收支账，而不是循环本身。

entries.definition: The area that collects the water; the cycle is the movement inside it.
entries.definitionCN: 收集水的区域；循环是在这个区域内发生的运动。

entries.definition: Any repeated going-round; the water cycle is one instance of circulation in nature.
entries.definitionCN: 任何反复绕行；水循环是自然界中循环的一个实例。

entries.definition: Movement of water in one direction only, without the return that makes a cycle.
entries.definitionCN: 水只朝一个方向流动，没有构成循环的回程。

entries.definition: Only the lifting stage; the cycle requires condensation, precipitation and return as well.
entries.definitionCN: 只是上升那一段；循环还需要凝结、降水与回归。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the two real roots, the four named stages and the diagram students actually draw.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：两个真实词根、四个有名字的阶段，以及学生真正会画的那张图。

normal.en: cycle is from Greek kyklos, a wheel: a wheel returns to the point where it started.
normal.cn: cycle 出自希腊语 kyklos「车轮」：轮子转一圈会回到起点。

normal.en: The four textbook labels are evaporation, condensation, precipitation and runoff, in that order.
normal.cn: 教材上的四个标签依次是蒸发、凝结、降水、径流。

normal.en: hydrological adds Greek hydōr, water, to logos, study: hydrology is the study of water's behaviour.
normal.cn: hydrological 是希腊语 hydōr「水」加 logos「研究」：水文学就是研究水的行为。

normal.en: The loop has two return roads: over the land and under it.
normal.cn: 这个回路有两条归路：一条在地面之上，一条在地面之下。

normal.en: The accounting rule is simple: what falls must equal what leaves plus what is stored.
normal.cn: 记账规则很简单：落下的量等于离开的量加上储存的量。

abstract.en: Abstractly, the cycle is a closed path with no ends: every exit is also an entrance.
abstract.cn: 抽象地看，这个循环是一条没有端点的闭合路径：每个出口同时也是一个入口。

abstract.en: It is also an energy story: sunlight lifts, gravity returns. Two forces drive one loop.
abstract.cn: 它也是一个能量故事：太阳负责抬起，重力负责送回。两种力驱动同一个回路。

abstract.en: Any system that must keep its accounts balanced and reuse the same material can be drawn with this loop.
abstract.cn: 任何必须保持收支平衡并重复使用同一材料的系统，都可以用这个回路来画。

examples.en: Deforestation can change the local water cycle and reduce rainfall.
examples.cn: 砍伐森林会改变局地水循环并减少降雨。

examples.en: The water cycle has no beginning and no end, so the arrows in the diagram can start anywhere.
examples.cn: 水循环没有起点也没有终点，所以示意图的箭头从哪一段开始画都可以。

examples.en: Warmer air speeds up the water cycle, making both floods and droughts more likely.
examples.cn: 更暖的空气加快水循环，使洪水和干旱都更容易发生。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「水（water）+ 圆圈（cycle）」——水在天上地下绕圈走，一圈接一圈 → 水循环

root: 古英语 wæter「水」+ 希腊语 kyklos「圆圈、转动」（经拉丁语 cyclus 进入英语）。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one loop: water leaves the surface, becomes cloud, falls, and returns by two roads, then the loop itself is counted, drawn and borrowed as a metaphor.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一个回路展开：水离开水面、变成云、落下来、沿两条路返回，随后这个回路本身被核算、被画成图，并被借作比喻。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: ocean → vapour → cloud → rain → land → ocean, a closed wheel of water.
core.cn: 核心意象：海洋 → 水汽 → 云 → 雨 → 陆地 → 海洋，一个闭合的水之轮。

branches.en: LIFTING AND COOLING: heat takes water up, cold air turns it back into droplets.
branches.cn: 抬升与冷却：热量把水送上去，冷空气把它变回水滴。

branches.en: THE DROP: what the air can no longer hold comes down as weather.
branches.cn: 落下的那一滴：空气再也托不住的水以天气的形式落下。

branches.en: TWO RETURN ROADS: across the surface into rivers, or down into rock.
branches.cn: 两条归路：或沿地表汇入河流，或向下进入岩层。

branches.en: BALANCE: the closed loop can be audited as a budget of inputs and outputs.
branches.cn: 平衡：这个闭合回路可以当作收支账来核算。

branches.en: MODEL AND METAPHOR: the arrows teach the loop, and any returning circulation borrows its name.
branches.cn: 模型与比喻：箭头把回路教给人，而任何会返回的循环都借用它的名字。

intro.en: Water cycle is a native-English compound with one Greek-derived member, so its pieces are readable: the substance plus a word for a round.
intro.cn: water cycle 是以英语本族词为主、含一个希腊来源成分的复合词，因此可以逐块读出：物质加「一圈」。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root for water here; the Latin element is cyclus, which Rome itself borrowed from Greek kyklos. Latin has its own circulus for a ring, a different formation, so it is not listed as a cognate.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有表示水的拉丁词根；拉丁成分是 cyclus，而这个词是罗马自己从希腊语 kyklos 借来的。拉丁语另有表示圆环的 circulus，构词来源不同，因此不作为同源词列出。

items.structure: water (Old English wæter, native word for the liquid)
items.meaning: the liquid itself; the substance that moves round
items.meaningCN: 水本身；循环中移动的物质
items.example: Water covers most of the planet's surface.
items.exampleCN: 水覆盖了这颗行星的大部分表面。

items.structure: cycle (Greek kyklos, circle, via Latin cyclus)
items.meaning: a round that returns to its start
items.example: The seasons form a yearly cycle.

items.meaning: the science of water on and under the earth
items.meaningCN: 研究地表与地下水的科学
items.example: Hydrology models how rain reaches rivers.
items.exampleCN: 水文学模拟降雨如何到达河流。

items.meaning: relating to the study or behaviour of water
items.meaningCN: 与水的研究或行为有关的
items.example: The map shows hydrological boundaries.

items.meaning: all the water of the planet taken as one layer
items.meaningCN: 把行星上全部水当作一个圈层
items.example: The hydrosphere exchanges heat with the atmosphere.

items.meaning: the change from liquid to vapour
items.meaningCN: 由液态变为水汽的过程
items.example: Evaporation from the sea feeds every cloud.
items.exampleCN: 海面的蒸发供养每一朵云。

items.meaning: the change from vapour back to droplets
items.meaningCN: 由水汽变回小水滴的过程
items.example: Condensation on the cold glass formed drops.
items.exampleCN: 冷玻璃上的凝结形成了水滴。

items.meaning: water falling from clouds as rain, snow or hail
items.meaningCN: 水以雨、雪或冰雹的形式从云中落下
items.example: Annual precipitation in the valley is low.
items.exampleCN: 这个谷地的年降水量很低。

items.meaning: water that flows away over the ground
items.example: Paved streets increase runoff.
items.exampleCN: 铺了路面的街道会增大径流。

items.meaning: the ridge that divides two drainage areas
items.meaningCN: 分开两个汇水区的分水岭
items.example: The watershed sends rain to two different rivers.
items.exampleCN: 分水岭把雨水送往两条不同的河。

latinEntries.structure: cyclus (Latin, borrowed from Greek kyklos, circle)

definition_zh: 以实验方式；实验性地；在实验中；通过实验证明地
definition_en: by means of an experiment, or in a tentative way that is still being tested
core_image: 一只手在记录本上写下“第 3 次试验”，旁边是刚刚调好的仪器刻度。
scene: 论文的方法部分说明这个效应不是靠推算。 The methods section says the effect was measured experimentally rather than inferred.
sceneCN: 这里指第 1 个义项。这里 experimentally 是「通过实验方式测定」（第 1、8 个义项）；句意：方法部分写明，这个效应是通过实验测得的，而不是靠推算。

pos.zh: 以实验方式；实验性地；通过实验地

senses.title: By experimental means
senses.titleCN: 以实验方式：靠动手试验而非推理
senses.definition: by carrying out an experiment rather than by reasoning alone
senses.definitionCN: 通过进行实验而非仅靠推理地
senses.example: The hypothesis was tested experimentally, not argued from first principles.
senses.exampleCN: 该假设是通过实验检验的，而不是从基本原理推出来的。
senses.why: The adverb answers the question How was this found out? The answer is a procedure: someone built a test and ran it.
senses.whyCN: 这个副词回答‘这是怎么知道的？’答案是程序：有人搭了测试并运行它。

senses.title: In the course of an experiment
senses.titleCN: 在实验中：作为实验过程的一部分
senses.definition: in the course of an experiment, as part of its procedure
senses.definitionCN: 在实验过程中，作为其程序的一部分
senses.example: The samples were handled experimentally under sterile conditions.
senses.exampleCN: 这些样本在无菌条件下按实验规程处理。
senses.why: Here the adverb places an action inside the experiment: the action is not merely tested, it belongs to the test's internal sequence.
senses.whyCN: 这里副词把动作放进实验内部：该动作不只是被检验，它属于实验内部的步骤序列。

senses.title: Confirmed by experiment
senses.titleCN: 经实验证明地：结果站住了
senses.definition: in a way that has been confirmed by experimental results
senses.definitionCN: 已被实验结果确认地
senses.example: The prediction was confirmed experimentally in two independent labs.
senses.exampleCN: 该预测在两个独立实验室中经实验得到确认。
senses.why: The adverb can mark epistemic status: the claim is not just tested but has passed the test, at least so far.
senses.whyCN: 这个副词可以标记认识论地位：该主张不只是被测试，而是通过了测试，至少截至目前。

senses.title: Tentatively, as a trial
senses.titleCN: 试验性地：先试一段时间再定
senses.definition: in a tentative way, as a trial rather than a final arrangement
senses.definitionCN: 以试探方式，作为试验而非最终安排地
senses.example: The team experimentally moved the meeting to Friday.
senses.exampleCN: 团队试验性地把会议改到了周五。
senses.why: Here the word has escaped the laboratory: any provisional action can be done experimentally, with the option of reversing it.
senses.whyCN: 这里这个词已经离开实验室：任何暂定行动都可以 experimental 地做，并保留撤回的选项。

senses.title: Methodologically
senses.titleCN: 在方法上：用实验法而非观察法
senses.definition: with respect to experimental method, as opposed to observation or theory
senses.definitionCN: 就实验方法而言，相对于观察或理论地
senses.example: The two groups were compared experimentally and statistically.
senses.exampleCN: 两组分别从实验和统计上作了比较。
senses.why: The adverb can distinguish a methodology from its neighbours: field observation records what happens, experimental work makes something happen.
senses.whyCN: 这个副词可以把一种方法论与邻居区分开：野外观察记录发生什么，实验工作则让某事发生。

senses.title: In a clinical trial
senses.titleCN: 在临床试验中：作为受试方案
senses.definition: as part of a clinical trial or an investigational treatment
senses.definitionCN: 作为临床试验或研究性治疗的一部分地
senses.example: The patient was treated experimentally under a strict protocol.
senses.exampleCN: 病人在严格方案下接受了试验性治疗。
senses.why: Medicine uses the adverb for care delivered inside a trial, where the protocol defines what may and may not be done.
senses.whyCN: 医学用这个副词指在试验内部提供的照护；方案定义了可以做什么、不可以做什么。

senses.title: In an experimental art practice
senses.titleCN: 在实验艺术中：以作品作为试验
senses.definition: in an avant-garde or trial-based artistic practice
senses.definitionCN: 以前卫或试验为基础的艺术实践中
senses.example: The composer worked experimentally with recorded noise.
senses.exampleCN: 这位作曲家以实验方式处理录制噪声。
senses.why: The adverb transfers the lab attitude to art: the work is made to see what happens, and failure is allowed to remain visible.
senses.whyCN: 这个副词把实验室态度转到艺术上：作品被做出来是为了看会发生什么，失败被允许留在明处。

senses.title: Measured by experiment
senses.titleCN: 以实验测定地：数值来自装置
senses.definition: by a measurement obtained through experimental apparatus
senses.definitionCN: 通过实验装置获得的测量地
senses.example: The constant was determined experimentally to four decimal places.
senses.exampleCN: 该常数由实验测定到四位小数。
senses.why: Here the focus is the number's origin: it came from an instrument and a procedure, not from a table or a calculation.
senses.whyCN: 这里聚焦数值的来源：它来自仪器与程序，而不是表格或计算。

intro.en: Experimentally is experimental plus -ly. The adjective comes from experiment, from Latin experimentum, a trial. The suffix -ly descends from Old English -lice.
intro.cn: experimentally 是 experimental 加 -ly。形容词来自 experiment，源头是拉丁 experimentum‘试验’。后缀 -ly 源自古典英语 -lice。

items.en: To try or test. Its past participle expertus also gives English expert: an expert is literally someone who has tried things.
items.cn: 尝试、检验。其过去分词 expertus 也给出英语 expert：专家字面上就是‘试过事情的人’。

items.en: A trial, test, or proof. The noun names both the procedure and the evidence it produces.
items.cn: 试验、检验、证明。该名词既命名程序，也命名程序产生的证据。

items.en: Borrowed in the 14c. Its meaning narrowed as the controlled method developed: a trial that deliberately changes one variable.
items.cn: 14 世纪借入。随着受控方法发展，词义收窄为‘有意改变一个变量的试验’。

items.en: The adjective appears in the 17c with the rise of demonstrative science. It marks both the method and the provisional status of the result.
items.cn: 形容词随 17 世纪演示科学兴起而出现。它同时标记方法与结果的暂定地位。

items.en: The adverb suffix -ly comes from Old English -lice, originally a distinct word meaning ‘body’ or ‘form’. It became the regular way to turn adjectives into manner adverbs.
items.cn: 副词后缀 -ly 来自古典英语 -lice，原是一个意为‘身体、形态’的独立词，后来成为把形容词变方式副词的常规手段。

items.en: The adverb spread from scientific writing into medicine, management, and art, wherever an action is described as a trial rather than a settled practice.
items.cn: 这个副词从科学写作扩展到医学、管理与艺术：凡是把行动描述为试验而非既定做法的地方都能用。

note.en: The first group is the experiment family; the second compares adverbs for how a claim is established or how cautiously an action is taken.
note.cn: 第一组是 experiment 词族；第二组比较表示‘如何确立主张’或‘行动有多谨慎’的副词。

entries.definition: relating to or based on an experiment. The adverb applies that property to the manner of an action.
entries.definitionCN: 与实验有关或基于实验的；副词把这一属性加到动作方式上。

entries.definition: a test, or to carry out a test. The adverb says the action was done through such a test.
entries.definitionCN: 试验，或进行试验；副词说明动作是通过这种试验完成的。

entries.definition: the practice of experimenting. It is the activity; experimentally is the manner.
entries.definitionCN: 进行实验的实践；是活动，experimentally 是方式。

entries.definition: the person who runs the test. It names the agent behind the adverb.
entries.definitionCN: 运行测试的人；命名副词背后的施动者。

entries.definition: by observation or experience rather than theory. It is broader than experimentally and includes field evidence.
entries.definitionCN: 通过观察或经验而非理论；比 experimentally 更宽，包含野外证据。

entries.definition: in a cautious, provisional way. It stresses hesitation rather than procedure.
entries.definitionCN: 以谨慎、暂定的方式；强调犹豫，而非程序。

entries.definition: in actual practice rather than in theory. It contrasts with theory, not with observation.
entries.definitionCN: 在实际做法中而非理论上；与理论相对，而非与观察相对。

entries.definition: by breaking a problem into parts. It is a desk method, often the opposite of hands-on testing.
entries.definitionCN: 把问题拆成部分来处理；是书桌方法，常与动手测试相对。

entries.definition: according to theory, or in principle. It marks the opposite source of knowledge to experimentally.
entries.definitionCN: 根据理论，或原则上；标记与 experimentally 相对的知识来源。

normalIntro.en: Real parts only: experimental plus -ly. The adverb says the action was done through a trial, or as a trial.
normalIntro.cn: 只用真实成分：experimental 加 -ly。这个副词说明动作是通过试验完成的，或本身就作为试验。

normal.en: Experimental plus -ly: in the manner of a test.
normal.cn: experimental 加 -ly：以测试的方式。

normal.en: Measured experimentally: the number came out of a machine, not a table.
normal.cn: measured experimentally：数字来自机器，不是表格。

normal.en: Confirmed experimentally: the claim survived contact with apparatus.
normal.cn: confirmed experimentally：主张经受住了与仪器的接触。

normal.en: Treated experimentally: the protocol, not the clinic routine, decides.
normal.cn: treated experimentally：由方案决定，而不是门诊常规。

normal.en: Moved experimentally: try Friday, and be ready to move it back.
normal.cn: moved experimentally：先试周五，并准备好改回来。

abstract.en: Experimentally is a confession about the source of a claim: hands made it, not arguments.
abstract.cn: experimentally 是对主张来源的坦白：是手做出来的，不是论证出来的。

abstract.en: The adverb quietly ranks knowledge: what is experimentally shown can still be overturned by a better experiment.
abstract.cn: 这个副词在悄悄给知识排序：实验证明的东西，仍可能被更好的实验推翻。

abstract.en: A society that values experimentally also has to tolerate failure, because trial and failure are one word.
abstract.cn: 重视 experimentally 的社会也必须容忍失败，因为试验与失败是同一个词的两面。

examples.en: The viscosity was determined experimentally at three temperatures.
examples.cn: 黏度在三个温度下通过实验测定。

examples.en: They experimentally introduced a four-day week and measured the effect on output.
examples.cn: 他们试验性地引入四天工作制，并测量对产出的影响。

examples.en: The drug was used experimentally long before it was approved.
examples.cn: 这种药在获批之前很久就被试验性使用了。

dict_mnemonic.text: “一颗死，配一闷头，里”——实验里一组死、一组闷头记录，里里外外都试过：experimentally 以实验方式。

root: 由 experimental 加 -ly 构成；experimental 源自拉丁 experimentum（试验），源头 experiri（尝试）。核心是“以试验的方式”或“作为试验地”。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of experimentally, one answer to How: through a test, inside a test, confirmed by a test, as a test, by test method, in a trial, in experimental art, or by instrument. The manner changes; the trial remains.
sensesIntro.cn: experimentally 的八个义项都在回答‘如何’：通过试验、在试验内、经试验确认、作为试验、用实验法、在临床试验中、在实验艺术中、用仪器测定。方式在变，试验不变。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand writing run number three beside a freshly set instrument.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手在刚调好的仪器旁写下‘第三次试验’。

chain: THE ACTION IS DONE THROUGH TESTING

branches.en: THE METHOD: the claim is produced by procedure rather than by argument.
branches.cn: 方法：主张由程序产生，而非由论证产生。

branches.en: INSIDE THE TRIAL: actions belong to the protocol rather than to ordinary life.
branches.cn: 试验进程内：动作属于既定方案，而不属于日常生活。

branches.en: THE VERIFIED NUMBER: confirmation and measurement both trace back to apparatus.
branches.cn: 被验证的数值：确认与测量都追溯回仪器。

branches.en: THE PROVISIONAL ACT: a Friday meeting and a noise composition are both trials with reversible outcomes.
branches.cn: 暂定行动：周五会议与噪声作曲都是结果可撤回的试验。

branches.en: THE CONSENT FRAME: medicine uses the adverb to mark care delivered under study conditions.
branches.cn: 知情同意框架：医学用这个副词标记在研究条件下提供的照护。

intro.en: Experimentally is experimental plus -ly. The family runs from experiment and experimentation to experimentalist and experimenter.
intro.cn: experimentally 是 experimental 加 -ly。词族从 experiment、experimentation 延伸到 experimentalist 与 experimenter。

latinIntro.en: The core Latin forms are experiri and experimentum, with the participle expertus behind English expert. The deeper per- connection is reconstructed.
latinIntro.cn: 核心拉丁形式是 experiri 与 experimentum，分词 expertus 是英语 expert 的来源。更深的 per- 联系属重构。

items.example: They ran the experiment twice.

items.meaning: based on or belonging to a test
items.example: The design is still experimental.
items.exampleCN: 这个设计仍是试验性的。

items.example: The value was obtained experimentally.
items.exampleCN: 该数值是通过实验得到的。

items.example: Experimentation preceded the final design.
items.exampleCN: 在最终设计之前先进行了实验。

items.example: The experimenter changed the order of trials.
items.exampleCN: 实验者改变了试验顺序。

items.example: The composer is an experimentalist by habit.
items.exampleCN: 这位作曲家习惯上是实验派。

items.meaningCN: 专家；有经过检验的知识的人
items.example: An expert reviewed the apparatus.

items.meaningCN: 经验；从实践得来的知识
items.example: Experience is a long series of trials.
The sea ice was a known peril.
The descent was perilous in the dark.

definition_zh: 不成功的；失败的；落空的
definition_en: not achieving the result that was intended
core_image: 一扇门推了三次都没开
scene: 年轻人提前半年准备面试，结果名单公布时还是没能进去。 He was unsuccessful in his attempt to join the team.
sceneCN: 这里 unsuccessful 是「不成功的」（第 1 个义项：没能达到目的）；句意为他那次想进这支队伍的尝试没有成功。推了三次都没开的门，正是这个词的核心。

derivatives.zh: 形容词加 -ly 构成副词，义为「不成功地；失败地」
去掉否定前缀后的肯定形式，义为「成功的」
同源动词，义为「成功；接替」

senses.title: Not reaching the goal
senses.definition: not achieving the aim one set out to reach
senses.definitionCN: 没有达到原先设定的目标
senses.example: The rescue attempt was unsuccessful, and the boat drifted on.
senses.exampleCN: 救援的尝试没有成功，船继续漂了下去。
senses.why: The word is the negative of successful, whose base success came to mean a good outcome.
senses.whyCN: 这个词是 successful 的反面，而 success 的本义已经变成「好的结果」。

senses.title: A request or application that is turned down
senses.definition: used of a formal request or application that is refused
senses.definitionCN: 形容正式申请或请求被拒绝
senses.example: His application for the scholarship was unsuccessful.
senses.exampleCN: 他的奖学金申请没有通过。
senses.why: An application is a formal attempt, and when it is refused the door simply does not open.
senses.whyCN: 申请是一种正式的尝试，被拒时那扇门就是没有开。

senses.title: Effort that brings no result
senses.definition: used of attempts that use effort but bring nothing
senses.definitionCN: 形容花了力气却毫无收获
senses.example: Their attempts to save the old tree were unsuccessful.
senses.exampleCN: 他们救那棵老树的努力白费了。
senses.why: The core image is effort pushing against a closed door, so the word naturally names work that yields nothing.
senses.whyCN: 核心画面是力气顶在一扇不开的门上，因此这个词自然用来形容花了力气却无所得。

senses.title: A person who has not yet succeeded in a field
senses.definition: used of a person who has not yet achieved recognition in a field
senses.definitionCN: 形容在某个领域尚未取得成就的人
senses.example: As an unsuccessful writer he taught school to pay the rent.
senses.exampleCN: 作为尚未成名的作家，他靠教书付房租。
senses.why: When the negative applies to a person, the idea shifts from the attempt to the standing that the attempt never brought.
senses.whyCN: 当否定落在人身上，这层意思就从「那次尝试」转到「尝试始终没带来的地位」。

senses.title: A search or test that finds nothing
senses.definition: used of a search, test, or trial that turns up no answer
senses.definitionCN: 形容查找、试验或审讯毫无答案
senses.example: An unsuccessful search for the key went on until dark.
senses.exampleCN: 找钥匙一直毫无结果，直到天黑。
senses.why: A search is an attempt aimed at a find, so a search that finds nothing is the same missed door.
senses.whyCN: 搜寻本就是奔着找到东西去的一次尝试，因此一无所获的搜寻还是那扇没开的门。

intro.en: A negative prefix over an adjective from Latin successus, a going up or a good outcome.
intro.cn: 否定前缀压在由拉丁语 successus（上升、好结果）来的形容词上。

items.en: The native prefix un- reverses the meaning of adjectives of any origin.
items.cn: 本土前缀 un- 可反转任何来源形容词的词义。

items.en: Succedere meant to come next or to go up from below.
items.cn: succedere 意为「随后而来」或「从下面升上去」。

items.en: The noun succès named the result of an affair, good or bad.
items.cn: 法语名词 succès 指一件事的结局，好坏皆可。

items.en: Success enters English in the sixteenth century and settles on the good outcome.
items.cn: success 于十六世纪进入英语，后来固定指「好的结果」。

items.en: Successful and then unsuccessful follow, first of events and later of people.
items.cn: 随后出现 successful 与 unsuccessful，先用于事件，后用于人。

note.en: The look-alike group follows the success family, and the near-meaning group collects words of failure and frustration.
note.cn: 形近组沿 success 词族展开，近义组汇集表示失败与落空的词。

entries.definition: reaching the aim
entries.definitionCN: 成功的

entries.definition: without success
entries.definitionCN: 不成功地

entries.definition: the achievement of an aim
entries.definitionCN: 成功

entries.definition: to do what was intended
entries.definitionCN: 成功；接替

entries.definition: a series of things one after another
entries.definitionCN: 连续；继任

entries.definition: having not succeeded
entries.definitionCN: 失败的

entries.definition: producing no result
entries.definitionCN: 无成果的

entries.definition: producing no effect
entries.definitionCN: 徒劳的

entries.definition: producing the intended result
entries.definitionCN: 有效的

normalIntro.en: The word is the negative of one of the most transparent adjectives in English.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词是英语里最透明的形容词之一的否定形式。

normal.en: Un- plus successful: the aim was set and not reached.
normal.cn: un- 加 successful：目标设在前面却没走到。

normal.en: Be unsuccessful in doing something is the fixed frame.
normal.cn: be unsuccessful in doing 是固定框架。

normal.en: An unsuccessful attempt and an unsuccessful application are the two common partners.
normal.cn: an unsuccessful attempt 与 an unsuccessful application 是两个常见搭配。

normal.en: Success, succeed, and succession all come from Latin succedere.
normal.cn: success、succeed、succession 都来自拉丁语 succedere。

normal.en: Weather reports say an overnight search proved unsuccessful.
normal.cn: 天气新闻里常说一夜的搜寻未能成功。

abstract.en: See a door that does not open after three pushes.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇推了三次都没开的门。

abstract.en: Watch a fishing boat come back with an empty net.
abstract.cn: 看一艘渔船带着空网回来。

abstract.en: Feel the small hesitation before you read a list of names.
abstract.cn: 体会在读名单之前的那一下迟疑。

examples.en: The first attempt to repair the bridge was unsuccessful.
examples.cn: 第一次修桥的尝试没有成功。

examples.en: She was unsuccessful in her application for a transfer.
examples.cn: 她的调动申请没有通过。

examples.en: Their search for the missing dog proved unsuccessful for two days.
examples.cn: 他们找那只走失的狗，两天都没有结果。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「俺塞成功」——怎么塞都塞不进去，成功俩字一直没能塞进手里。

root: 英语本土构词：前缀 un-（不）+ successful（成功的），successful 来自名词 success，success 源自拉丁语 successus / succedere（随之而来、由下升起）

sensesIntro.en: One idea, the aim was missed, covers attempts, applications, wasted effort, careers, and fruitless searches.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个意思「目标没落到手」，覆盖尝试、申请、白费力气、事业与毫无结果的查找。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a door that does not give way.
core.cn: 核心意象：一扇怎么推也不让开的门。

branches.en: The plain branch: the goal simply was not reached.
branches.cn: 朴素分支：目标就是没达到。

branches.en: The formal branch: an application comes back refused.
branches.cn: 正式分支：申请被退回来。

branches.en: The waste branch: effort that leaves nothing behind.
branches.cn: 落空分支：力气花完什么也没留下。

branches.en: The career branch: someone still waiting to be recognised.
branches.cn: 事业分支：仍在等被看见的人。

branches.en: The search branch: a hunt that turns up nothing.
branches.cn: 查访分支：一无所获的搜寻。

intro.en: A native negative prefix sits over a Latin-derived adjective whose own suffix is very common.
intro.cn: 本土否定前缀压在拉丁来源的形容词上，其自身的后缀非常常见。

latinIntro.en: The Latin source is succedere, made of sub- under and cedere to go.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁来源是 succedere，由 sub-（在下）与 cedere（走）组成。

items.example: Unsuccessful means not successful.
Succedere begins with sub- before c moved.
items.exampleCN: succedere 在 c 前用了 sub- 的变体。

items.example: Cedere underlies proceed and concede.
items.exampleCN: cedere 是 proceed 与 concede 的词根。

items.example: Success gives successful.
Unsuccessful gives unsuccessfully.
Succedere gives succession.
The show was a success.
She had a successful year.
His try was unsuccessful.

items.meaning: to come after or do well
items.example: He succeeded his father.

latinEntries.meaning: to come after, to go up

definition_zh: 赎罪；弥补；补偿；（神学）和解
definition_en: the act of making amends for a wrong; reparation, especially in a religious sense
core_image: 天平一端放着过错，一端慢慢加上的弥补之石
scene: 教堂的烛光里，他把写满悔意的信一页页读完，然后起身走向那位多年未见的老友。 The letter was his atonement for the quarrel that split the family.
sceneCN: 这里 atonement 是「赎罪、弥补」（第 1 个义项：为过错所作的补偿行为）；句意为这封信是他为造成家庭分裂的争吵所作的补偿。

derivatives.zh: 动词本源，义为「赎罪；弥补」
由动词加人后缀构成，义为「赎罪者」

senses.title: The act of making amends
senses.definition: repayment or reparation for injury or wrong
senses.definitionCN: 对伤害或过错的偿还与补救
senses.example: Rebuilding the school was his atonement.
senses.exampleCN: 重建学校便是他的赎罪。
senses.why: From at one: amends reunite what the wrong divided.
senses.whyCN: 源自 at one：弥补使被过错拆散者重聚。

senses.title: Religious reconciliation with God
senses.definition: the reconciling of God and humanity, especially through sacrifice
senses.definitionCN: 神人与解，尤指藉献祭达成的救赎
senses.example: The sermon spoke of atonement through sacrifice.
senses.exampleCN: 布道讲到藉献祭而得的救赎。
senses.why: Theology kept the oldest sense: sin tears, sacrifice restores oneness.
senses.whyCN: 神学保留了最古老的意义：罪使人撕裂，献祭恢复合一。

intro.en: Atonement is at one plus -ment, first written as two words meaning reconciliation, later fused into one theological term.
intro.cn: atonement 由 at one 加 -ment 构成，初作两词写作、意为和解，后凝缩为神学术语。

items.en: An meant one.
items.cn: 古英语 an 意为一。

items.en: At one described setting disputants at unity.
items.cn: 中古英语 at one 表示使争执者归于一体。

items.en: Tyndale coined atonement to render Greek reconciliation in the New Testament.
items.cn: 十六世纪廷代尔以 atonement 翻译《新约》中的「和好」一词。

items.en: It became the fixed theological noun for Christ's reconciling work.
items.cn: 它成为指基督救赎之工的固定神学名词。

items.en: Everyday use now covers any formal or moral amends.
items.cn: 如今日常用法泛指一切正式或道德上的补偿。

note.en: Atonement is the price and the process of becoming at one again.
note.cn: atonement 是重新「合而为一」的代价与过程。

entries.definition: the verb of making amends
entries.definitionCN: 赎罪（同根动词）

entries.definition: music without key, unrelated root
entries.definitionCN: 无调性的（形近，词源不同）

entries.definition: similar shape, different root
entries.definitionCN: 成就（形近，词源不同）

entries.definition: formal amends for guilt
entries.definitionCN: 赎罪（正式近义词）

entries.definition: the Jewish Day of Atonement
entries.definitionCN: 赎罪日（相关概念）

entries.definition: payment for wrong or damage
entries.definitionCN: 赔偿；补偿

entries.definition: deliverance from sin or fault
entries.definitionCN: 救赎

entries.definition: voluntary self-punishment for sin
entries.definitionCN: 苦修；补赎

entries.definition: restoring friendly relations
entries.definitionCN: 和解

entries.definition: returning what was taken
entries.definitionCN: 归还；赔偿

normalIntro.en: Atonement = at-one-ment: the state of being one after the split.
normalIntro.cn: atonement = at-one-ment：破裂之后重归合一的状态。

normal.en: built from at one plus -ment.
normal.cn: 由 at one 加 -ment 构成。

normal.en: Tyndale coined it for the Bible.
normal.cn: 廷代尔为译经而造此词。

normal.en: Day of Atonement is Yom Kippur.
normal.cn: 赎罪日即犹太教的 Yom Kippur。

normal.en: verb is atone, usually with for.
normal.cn: 动词是 atone，常接 for。

normal.en: atonal is a false cousin.
normal.cn: atonal 是假表亲。

abstract.en: Picture weights added until the scale rests level.
abstract.cn: 想象加上的砝码让天平归于平息。

abstract.en: See a bridge rebuilt over a broken road.
abstract.cn: 看见断路上重建的桥。

abstract.en: Feel the quiet after an apology is accepted.
abstract.cn: 体会道歉被接受后的宁静。

examples.en: He offered labor as atonement for the damage.
examples.cn: 他以劳作赔偿造成的损失。

examples.en: The novel is a study in guilt and atonement.
examples.cn: 这部小说是对罪与赎的探究。

examples.en: Atonement, in theology, restores the broken bond.
examples.cn: 在神学中，救赎修复破裂的纽带。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「额痛门特」——额痛悔而入门忏悔，赎罪弥补即 atonement。

root: 古英语 an（一）→ 中古英语 at one（使合而为一）→ 廷代尔造 atonement（和解、赎罪）→ 现代泛指补偿。

sensesIntro.en: The noun of at-one-ment covers both moral repayment and divine reconciliation.
sensesIntro.cn: 「合一」的名词化既涵盖道德偿还，也涵盖神人和解。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: scales resting level again after the debt is paid
core.cn: 核心意象：债偿清后天平重新归平

branches.en: moral repayment for wrong
branches.cn: 为过错的道德偿还

branches.en: divine-human reconciliation
branches.cn: 神人的和解

branches.en: the at-one image at work
branches.cn: 「合一」意象的两种落点

branches.en: sacrifice restoring the bond
branches.cn: 以献祭修复纽带

branches.en: formal amends, as reparations
branches.cn: 正式补偿，如赔款

intro.en: The -ment suffix fixes the becoming-one into a state or act.
intro.cn: 后缀 -ment 把「复归合一」固定为状态或行为。

latinIntro.en: No Latin core: the word is an English coinage from native parts.
latinIntro.cn: 无拉丁词核：这是用本土部件铸成的英语词。

definition_zh: 工业社会（以工业生产为主导的社会形态）
definition_en: a society whose economy and daily life are organized around manufacturing industry
core_image: 厂房、工人宿舍、铁路与钟楼围成一座自足的城市，汽笛决定一天的节奏
scene: 老照片里，上班的人流在天未亮时涌向厂门，汽笛一响整条街都醒了。 Industrial society brought the factory clock into everyday life.
sceneCN: 这里 industrial society 指「以工业生产为主导组织起来的社会」（第 1 个义项：以制造业为基础的社会）；句意为工业社会把工厂的时钟带进了日常生活。图中可辨识物件：厂房、宿舍、铁路、钟楼、涌向厂门的人流。

senses.title: A society built on manufacturing
senses.titleCN: 以制造业为基础的社会
senses.definition: a society whose wealth, work and daily rhythm centre on factory production
senses.definitionCN: 财富、工作与日常节奏都以工厂生产为中心的社会
senses.example: Industrial society brought the factory clock into everyday life.
senses.exampleCN: 工业社会把工厂的时钟带进了日常生活。
senses.why: the phrase simply names a society of the industrial kind, with industry as its organizing centre.
senses.whyCN: 这个短语直接命名一种工业类型的社会，以工业为其组织中心。

senses.title: A stage in development typology
senses.titleCN: 发展阶段类型中的一个阶段
senses.definition: one stage in the classification that runs from agrarian to industrial to post-industrial societies
senses.definitionCN: 从农业社会到工业社会再到后工业社会的分类中的一个阶段
senses.example: Sociologists placed the country at the industrial stage of the typology.
senses.exampleCN: 社会学者把这个国家归入类型学中的工业阶段。
senses.why: a type becomes a stage when societies are arranged along a single line of development.
senses.whyCN: 当社会被排在同一条发展线上时，一个类型就变成一个阶段。

senses.title: A concept in early sociology
senses.titleCN: 早期社会学的一个概念
senses.definition: the model of modern society that nineteenth-century sociology built around industry and its division of labour
senses.definitionCN: 19 世纪社会学围绕工业及其分工所建立的现代社会模型
senses.example: Industrial society was the central concept of the discipline's founders.
senses.exampleCN: 工业社会是该学科创立者们的核心概念。
senses.why: early sociologists needed a name for the new order they saw replacing agrarian life.
senses.whyCN: 早期社会学者需要给眼前取代农业生活的新秩序一个名字。

senses.title: Its class and work structure
senses.definition: the social order of wage labour, employers and classes that factory production creates
senses.definitionCN: 工厂生产所造成的雇佣劳动、雇主与阶级的社会秩序
senses.example: Industrial society produced a large working class and a small owning class.
senses.exampleCN: 工业社会产生了一个庞大的工人阶级与一个很小的有产阶层。
senses.why: the factory gathers many workers under one employer, and that arrangement shapes the whole class structure.
senses.whyCN: 工厂把许多工人聚到同一个雇主之下，这一安排塑造了整个阶级结构。

senses.title: Its characteristic institutions
senses.definition: the school, the bureaucracy, the clock and the city that industrial organization requires
senses.definitionCN: 工业组织所需要的学校、官僚机构、时钟与城市
senses.example: Compulsory schooling was an institution of industrial society.
senses.exampleCN: 义务教育是工业社会的一项制度。
senses.why: industry needs punctual, literate, disciplined workers, so it builds institutions that produce them.
senses.whyCN: 工业需要守时、识字、守纪律的工人，因此它建起生产这类人的制度。

senses.title: A historical period
senses.definition: the era, roughly from the late eighteenth to the late twentieth century, when industry dominated
senses.definitionCN: 大约从 18 世纪末到 20 世纪末、工业占主导的时代
senses.example: The photographs document industrial society at its height.
senses.exampleCN: 这些照片记录了工业社会的鼎盛时期。
senses.why: a social type with a beginning and an end becomes a period that historians can date.
senses.whyCN: 一个有始有终的社会类型会成为历史学者可以断代的时期。

senses.title: The contrast with post-industrial society
senses.definition: the older order against which service-based and knowledge-based societies define themselves
senses.definitionCN: 以服务业与知识为基础的社会用来定义自身的那个较早秩序
senses.example: Post-industrial society is defined by what industrial society was not.
senses.exampleCN: 后工业社会是靠工业社会「不是」什么来定义的。
senses.why: once a successor type is named, the older phrase becomes a benchmark rather than a description.
senses.whyCN: 一旦后继类型被命名，较早的短语就成为基准，而不只是描述。

senses.title: A target of ecological critique
senses.definition: the order criticized for treating nature as a supply of inputs and for generating risk
senses.definitionCN: 被批评为把自然当作投入来源并制造风险的那种秩序
senses.example: Green theorists blame industrial society for the climate crisis.
senses.exampleCN: 绿色理论家把气候危机归咎于工业社会。
senses.why: critics turn the descriptive phrase into an accusation by attaching pollution and risk to its way of producing.
senses.whyCN: 批评者把污染与风险归到它的生产方式上，从而把描述性短语变成指控。

intro.en: Industrial is built on Latin industria 'diligence, activity'; society comes from Latin societas 'companionship, association', from socius 'ally'. The phrase belongs to nineteenth-century social thought. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: industrial 由拉丁 industria「勤勉、活动」构成；society 来自拉丁 societas「同伴关系、结社」，其词根为 socius「盟友」。这个短语属于 19 世纪的社会思想。年代均为约数。

items.en: Industria meant 'diligence, purposeful activity'; its deeper origin is unsettled, and the derivation sometimes offered from indu- plus struere 'to build' is a hypothesis.
items.cn: industria 意为「勤勉、有目的的活动」；其更深来源尚无定论，有人提出它由 indu- 与 struere「建造」构成，那只是假说。

items.en: Socius meant 'companion, ally', and societas named the bond or association among such people. The deeper origin of socius is not established.
items.cn: socius 意为「同伴、盟友」，societas 指这些人之间的纽带或结社。socius 的更深来源未得到证明。

items.en: Industry shifted from diligence to manufacturing in the eighteenth century, and industrial was coined to describe it.
items.cn: industry 在 18 世纪从「勤勉」转向「制造业」，industrial 随之被造出来描述它。

items.en: Society entered English through French and came to mean an organized collectivity, not merely company.
items.cn: society 经法语进入英语，逐渐指有组织的集体，而不只是作伴。

items.en: Social thinkers of the nineteenth century paired the two words to name the new order built on factories, wage labour and cities.
items.cn: 19 世纪的社会思想家把这两个词配对，用来命名建立在工厂、雇佣劳动与城市之上的新秩序。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origins and first date): the pre-Latin origins of industria and socius are reconstructions, and the earliest use of the exact phrase is not precisely recorded.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词源与首见年代）：industria 与 socius 在拉丁语之前的来源属重构形式；这一确切短语的最早使用没有精确记录。

note.en: Group one holds industrial compounds and related words that look alike; group two holds other labels for modern social orders.
note.cn: 第一组是外形相近的工业类组合词与相关词；第二组是对现代社会秩序的其他称谓。

entries.definition: The economic order of privately owned industry and wage labour; it names the system, while industrial society names the society.
entries.definitionCN: 私有工业与雇佣劳动的经济秩序；命名的是制度，而工业社会命名的是社会。

entries.definition: A society that has completed industrialization, stressing the outcome rather than the social type.
entries.definitionCN: 已完成工业化的社会，强调结果而非社会类型。

entries.definition: The system of industrial organization, or belief in it as the proper basis of society.
entries.definitionCN: 工业组织的制度，或对其作为社会适当基础的信念。

entries.definition: The period of rapid mechanization that produced industrial society; the phrase names the change, not the resulting order.
entries.definitionCN: 带来工业社会的快速机械化时期；命名的是变化，而非形成后的秩序。

entries.definition: A society whose economy centres on services and knowledge rather than manufacturing.
entries.definitionCN: 经济以服务业与知识而非制造业为中心的社会。

entries.definition: A society organized around farming and land ownership, the type industrial society replaced.
entries.definitionCN: 围绕农业与土地所有权组织的社会，是工业社会所取代的类型。

entries.definition: A broad label for contemporary social orders; it includes industry but also politics, science and culture.
entries.definitionCN: 对当代社会秩序的宽泛称谓；包含工业，也包含政治、科学与文化。

entries.definition: A society of large-scale, impersonal organization and mass culture; it overlaps with industrial society but stresses conformity.
entries.definitionCN: 以大规模、非人格化组织与大众文化为特征的社会；与工业社会重叠，但强调趋同。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real fixed phrases and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实的固定搭配与真实的同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Industrial describes the economy, society the people, so the phrase is a society organized around industry.
normal.cn: 工业的描述经济，社会的指人群，因此这个短语是围绕工业组织起来的社会。

normal.en: The typology runs agrarian, industrial, post-industrial in that order.
normal.cn: 类型学按农业、工业、后工业的顺序排列。

normal.en: The factory clock, the school and the city are its institutions.
normal.cn: 工厂时钟、学校与城市是它的制度。

normal.en: Fixed phrases such as mature industrial society and transition to an industrial society mark the historical senses.
normal.cn: 成熟的工业社会、向工业社会过渡这类固定搭配标出历史义。

normal.en: The phrase is descriptive, but critics turn it into an accusation.
normal.cn: 这个短语本为描述，但批评者会把它变成指控。

abstract.en: Picture a town whose bell tower has been replaced by a whistle nobody can ignore.
abstract.cn: 想象一座小镇的钟楼被一只谁也躲不开的汽笛取代。

abstract.en: Picture a classroom, a factory and a railway station built from the same grey brick.
abstract.cn: 想象教室、工厂与车站都用同一种灰砖建成。

abstract.en: Picture a river that carries goods instead of fish.
abstract.cn: 想象一条河里运的是货物而不是鱼。

examples.en: Industrial society expanded schooling to produce literate workers.
examples.cn: 工业社会扩张学校教育，以培养识字工人。

examples.en: The novel describes industrial society through one factory town.
examples.cn: 这部小说通过一座工厂城镇描写工业社会。

examples.en: Critics of industrial society pointed to pollution and alienation.
examples.cn: 工业社会的批评者指出了污染与疏离。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「工业的（industrial）+ 社会（society）」——工厂与汽笛组织起来的社会，就是工业社会

root: 拉丁 industria「勤勉、活动」→ industrial；拉丁 socius「同伴」→ societas「结社」→ society。两词在 19 世纪社会思想中固定连用。两词的更深来源均不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one kind of society: the factory-centred order, its place in a typology, its role in early sociology, its class structure, its institutions, its historical period, its contrast with the post-industrial, and its use as an ecological accusation.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项围绕同一种社会展开：以工厂为中心的秩序、它在类型学中的位置、它在早期社会学中的角色、它的阶级结构、它的制度、它的历史时期、它与后工业的对照，以及它作为生态指控的用法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a factory gate, a whistle, a school and a station all set within one grey town.
core.cn: 核心意象：厂门、汽笛、学校与车站都装在同一座灰色城镇里。

branches.en: CENTRE: the base sense, a society whose working life turns around manufacturing.
branches.cn: 中心：基础义，工作生活围绕制造业运转的社会。

branches.en: PLACE IN TIME: a stage in the typology and, later, a dated historical period.
branches.cn: 时间中的位置：类型学中的一个阶段，后来又成为一个可断代的时期。

branches.en: MODEL AND CLASSES: a concept built by early sociology, and the wage-labour order it described.
branches.cn: 模型与阶级：早期社会学建立的概念，以及它所描述的雇佣劳动秩序。

branches.en: INSTITUTIONS: the clock, the school and the city that industry requires.
branches.cn: 制度：工业所需的时钟、学校与城市。

branches.en: AFTERWARD AND AGAINST: the benchmark set by post-industrial society, and the ecological charge laid against it.
branches.cn: 之后与反对：后工业社会树立的基准，以及针对它的生态指控。

intro.en: The phrase joins an adjective of industry to a noun of association, and both halves carry productive pieces.
intro.cn: 这个短语把一个工业形容词与一个结社名词连在一起，两半都带着能产的构词成分。

latinIntro.en: Latin industria gives industry, industrial and industrialization; Latin socius gives society, social and associate.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 industria 给出 industry、industrial 与 industrialization；拉丁 socius 给出 society、social 与 associate。

items.example: The root first named effort, then manufacturing.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根先指努力，后来指制造业。

items.example: It forms the adjective of industry.
Industrial output doubled in a decade.

It names the industrial order as a system.
