definition_zh: 围绕订婚、婚礼与婚后生活形成的传统做法与规矩
definition_en: the traditional practices and rules that surround engagement, wedding ceremonies and the start of married life
core_image: 喜堂门口摆着两双新鞋，桌上一盘红枣与花生，来客按辈分依次拱手
scene: 喜堂的门口摆着两双新鞋，桌上放着一盘红枣和花生，来客按辈分依次行礼。 Village marriage customs require the bride to circle the fire three times.
sceneCN: 这里 marriage customs 指「围绕婚事形成的传统做法与规矩」（第 1 个义项：一整套在婚礼前后被遵循的习俗）；句意为村里的婚姻习俗要求新娘绕火三圈。可辨识物件：新鞋、红枣、花生、喜堂、火盆。

pos.zh: 婚姻习俗（复数名词短语）

senses.title: Traditional practices around a wedding
senses.titleCN: 婚礼前后遵循的传统做法
senses.definition: the expected actions and taboos that a community follows when a couple marry
senses.definitionCN: 一个社群在两人成婚时所遵循的既定行为与禁忌
senses.example: Village marriage customs require the bride to circle the fire three times.
senses.exampleCN: 村里的婚姻习俗要求新娘绕火三圈。
senses.why: custom is habitual practice, and marriage is the occasion where practice is most tightly scripted.
senses.whyCN: custom 指习惯性做法，而婚姻正是这种做法被规定得最细的场合。

senses.title: Practices of betrothal
senses.definition: the steps of proposing, negotiating and formally promising a future marriage
senses.definitionCN: 提亲、商谈并正式许诺未来婚事的各个步骤
senses.example: Betrothal customs in that region begin with a gift of tea.
senses.exampleCN: 该地区的订婚习俗以送茶开始。
senses.why: the wedding is the visible end, so most of the customs begin earlier and quietly.
senses.whyCN: 婚礼是看得见的终点，因此许多习俗更早、更安静地开始。

senses.title: Exchange of bride price and dowry
senses.definition: the transfer of goods or money between the families of the bride and groom
senses.definitionCN: 新娘与新郞两家之间转移财物或金钱
senses.example: Marriage customs once fixed the amount of the bride price.
senses.exampleCN: 婚姻习俗曾规定聘礼的数额。
senses.why: a marriage joins two households as well as two people, and goods mark that join.
senses.whyCN: 婚姻既连接两个人，也连接两户人家，财物正是这一连接的标记。

senses.title: Symbolic acts in the ceremony
senses.titleCN: 婚礼仪式中的象征行为
senses.definition: gestures such as exchanging rings, veiling the bride or circling a fire that carry meaning beyond the literal act
senses.definitionCN: 交换戒指、为新娘盖头、绕火等带有字面之外含义的动作
senses.example: The rings are only one of many symbolic marriage customs.
senses.exampleCN: 戒指只是众多象征性婚姻习俗之一。
senses.why: customs work by symbol: a small act stands for a large promise.
senses.whyCN: 习俗靠象征运作：一个小动作代表一个大承诺。

senses.title: Rules about where the couple lives
senses.definition: the expectation that a new couple lives with the groom's or the bride's family
senses.definitionCN: 新婚夫妇随夫家或随妻家居住的期待
senses.example: Marriage customs in the valley favour living near the husband's parents.
senses.exampleCN: 山谷里的婚姻习俗偏向住在丈夫父母附近。
senses.why: residence decides which household gains a worker, so it is a rule, not a detail.
senses.whyCN: 居住地决定哪一户多得一个劳动力，因此它是规则而非细节。

senses.title: Marriage taboos and prohibitions
senses.titleCN: 与婚姻相关的禁忌与禁例
senses.definition: rules forbidding certain partners, dates or actions as dangerous or impure
senses.definitionCN: 因危险或不洁而禁止某些配偶、日期或行为的规则
senses.example: Customs forbade marriage between people sharing a surname.
senses.exampleCN: 习俗禁止同姓者通婚。
senses.why: every custom has a fence, and marriage customs fence off who may marry whom.
senses.whyCN: 每种习俗都有围栏，而婚姻习俗围住的是谁可以与谁成婚。

senses.title: Comparison across cultures
senses.titleCN: 不同文化婚姻习俗的比较
senses.definition: the scholarly description and comparison of wedding practices in different societies
senses.definitionCN: 对不同社会中婚礼做法的学术描述与比较
senses.example: The course compares marriage customs from six regions.
senses.exampleCN: 这门课程比较六个地区的婚姻习俗。
senses.why: once practices are written down, they become objects that can be set side by side.
senses.whyCN: 做法一旦被记录下来，就成了可以并排放置的对象。

senses.title: Simplification and revival today
senses.titleCN: 当代的简化与传统习俗的复兴
senses.definition: the modern trimming of elaborate rites and the deliberate return to older forms
senses.definitionCN: 现代对繁复礼仪的删减，以及有意回归旧形式
senses.example: Young couples now mix civil marriage customs with a traditional tea rite.
senses.exampleCN: 年轻夫妻如今把民事婚姻习俗与传统敬茶礼混在一起。
senses.why: customs survive by being edited, not by being frozen.
senses.whyCN: 习俗靠被改写而存活，而非靠被冻结。

intro.en: Marriage customs joins marriage, from Latin maritus 'husband' through Old French, with custom, from Latin consuetudo 'habit, usage' through Old French costume. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: marriage customs 由 marriage 与 custom 合成：marriage 经古法语来自拉丁 maritus「丈夫」，custom 经古法语 costume 来自拉丁 consuetudo「习惯、惯例」。年代均为约数。

items.en: Maritus meant 'husband', and maritare 'to wed' produced Old French mariage and English marriage. The deeper origin of maritus is uncertain, and the link to mas 'male' is only a hypothesis.
items.cn: maritus 意为「丈夫」，动词 maritare「使成婚」衍生出古法语 mariage 与英语 marriage。maritus 的更深来源不确定，与 mas「男性」的联系仅是假说。

items.en: Consuetudo meant 'habit, custom, usage', built on consuescere 'to accustom', itself con- 'thoroughly' plus suescere 'to become used'.
items.cn: consuetudo 意为「习惯、风俗、惯例」，由 consuescere「使习惯」构成，而后者是 con-「彻底」加 suescere「变得习惯」。

items.en: Old French costume carried both 'habit' and 'usual practice' into English, where custom kept the social sense.
items.cn: 古法语 costume 把「习惯」与「惯常做法」带入英语，custom 保留了社会性含义。

items.en: English joined the two nouns to name the rules that surround a wedding, usually in the plural because a wedding is a sequence of acts.
items.cn: 英语把这两个名词组合起来，指围绕婚礼的规矩；因婚礼是一连串动作，通常用复数。

items.en: Comparative anthropology made marriage customs a standard category for describing how societies arrange unions.
items.cn: 比较人类学使 marriage customs 成为描述各社会如何安排婚姻的标准类别。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date): the plural phrase is recorded only from modern field reports, and no single first use is fixed.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代）：这个复数短语只见于近代田野报告，没有确切的最早书证。

note.en: Group one holds words built from the same two stems; group two holds terms for rules and rites that are often confused with custom.
note.cn: 第一组是同出这两个词干的词；第二组是常与 custom 混淆的规则与仪式类词。

entries.definition: A habitual practice of a group; marriage customs are the practices attached to one occasion.
entries.definitionCN: 指群体的习惯性做法；婚姻习俗则是附着于某一场合的做法。

entries.definition: Means 'according to custom'; it describes a practice, while the noun names it.
entries.definitionCN: 意为「按习俗的」；它描述做法，名词则指做法本身。

entries.definition: From the same Old French word in the sense of habitual use: one who comes habitually to a shop.
entries.definitionCN: 来自同一古法语词的「惯常使用」义：习惯性来店里的人。

entries.definition: The same Old French word that gave custom, now meaning dress; the two meanings split in English.
entries.definitionCN: 与 custom 同出一个古法语词，今指服装；两个含义在英语中分化。

entries.definition: A prescribed religious or solemn act; customs may include rites but are broader and less formal.
entries.definitionCN: 指规定的宗教或庄严行为；习俗可包含仪式，但范围更广、更不正式。

entries.definition: Anything passed from generation to generation; custom stresses repeated practice rather than age alone.
entries.definitionCN: 指代代相传的一切；custom 强调反复实践，而不只是年代久远。

entries.definition: A rule accepted by agreement, often recent; custom is older and unwritten.
entries.definitionCN: 指经同意而被接受的规则，往往较新；custom 更古老且不成文。

entries.definition: A rule enforced by a state; a custom may be written into law, but it begins without that force.
entries.definitionCN: 指由国家强制执行的规则；习俗可被写入法律，但它起初并无这种强制力。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real word partnerships and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: marriage comes from maritus 'husband'; custom comes from consuetudo 'habit'.
normal.cn: marriage 来自 maritus「丈夫」；custom 来自 consuetudo「习惯」。

normal.en: The plural is normal because a wedding is a chain of small acts, not one act.
normal.cn: 用复数很正常，因为婚礼是一连串小动作，而非单个动作。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: local marriage customs, traditional marriage customs, observe marriage customs.
normal.cn: 固定搭配：地方婚姻习俗、传统婚姻习俗、遵守婚姻习俗。

normal.en: The family runs custom, customary, customer and customize, though their meanings have drifted apart.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 custom、customary、customer 与 customize，但词义已经分化。

normal.en: Anthropology treats the phrase as a category for comparison, not as advice for couples.
normal.cn: 人类学把这个短语当作比较类别，而非给新人的建议。

abstract.en: Picture a script passed down for a wedding nobody remembers writing.
abstract.cn: 想象一场婚礼的脚本代代相传，却没人记得是谁写的。

abstract.en: Picture two families exchanging goods as a sentence exchanges subjects.
abstract.cn: 想象两户人家交换财物，就像句子交换主语。

abstract.en: Picture a fence built from habits rather than from wood.
abstract.cn: 想象一道用习惯而非木头筑成的围栏。

examples.en: The museum collected photographs of marriage customs from fifty villages.
examples.cn: 博物馆收集了五十个村庄的婚姻习俗照片。

examples.en: Migration changed marriage customs faster than law did.
examples.cn: 迁徙改变婚姻习俗的速度快于法律。

examples.en: Some marriage customs survive mainly as performance for visitors.
examples.cn: 有些婚姻习俗如今主要作为给游客看的表演而存在。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「marriage（婚姻）+ customs（习俗）」——办喜事时一套套的老规矩

root: marriage 来自拉丁 maritus「丈夫」经古法语 mariage；custom 来自拉丁 consuetudo「习惯、惯例」经古法语 costume。maritus 的更深来源不确定，与 mas「男性」的联系仅为假说。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one script: a community writes down how a marriage should be made, and that script covers betrothal, goods, symbols, residence, taboos, comparison and modern revision.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一套脚本展开：一个社群写下婚事应当如何办，这套脚本涵盖订婚、财物、象征、居住、禁忌、比较与现代改写。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a wedding script written in gestures rather than words, performed in the same order each time.
core.cn: 核心意象：一份用动作而非文字写成的婚礼脚本，每次按同样顺序演出。

branches.en: THE WHOLE SCRIPT: the phrase names the full set of expected actions before any single one.
branches.cn: 整套脚本：这个短语先指全部被期待的动作，再指其中任何一项。

branches.en: BEFORE AND ACROSS: betrothal is the quiet opening, and comparison turns the script into an object of study.
branches.cn: 之前与横比：订婚是安静的开端，比较则把脚本变成研究对象。

branches.en: GOODS THAT BIND: the transfer of wealth is a sentence spoken in objects.
branches.cn: 以物相系：财物的转移是用物件说出的句子。

branches.en: SIGNS AND FENCES: symbolic acts say what is promised, and taboos say what is forbidden.
branches.cn: 符号与围栏：象征动作说出承诺，禁忌说出禁止。

branches.en: WHERE AND WHETHER: residence decides who gains a worker, and revival decides which parts still speak.
branches.cn: 住在哪与是否延续：居住决定谁多得劳力，复兴决定哪些部分仍有话说。

intro.en: The phrase combines a Latin-derived noun of marriage with a Latin-derived noun of habit, and both stems carry their own suffixes into English.
intro.cn: 这个短语把一个源自拉丁的婚姻名词与一个源自拉丁的习惯名词组合起来，两个词干都带着各自的后缀进入英语。

latinIntro.en: Latin maritus and consuetudo stand behind the two halves; -age turns the wedding act into a state, while the custom family loses its Latin ending in French.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 maritus 与 consuetudo 分别是两半的来源；-age 把成婚之举变成状态，而 custom 一族在法语中丢掉了拉丁词尾。

items.example: The first half of the phrase begins with the husband.
items.exampleCN: 短语的前一半从丈夫说起。

items.example: The verb supplied the French noun of marriage.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词提供了法语的婚姻名词。

items.example: The suffix makes a state out of an act.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把行为变成状态。

items.example: Marriage names what the customs surround.
items.exampleCN: marriage 指习俗所围绕的那件事。

items.example: Consuetudo is the source of the second half.
items.exampleCN: consuetudo 是短语后一半的来源。

items.example: A custom is what a group has grown used to.
items.exampleCN: 习俗就是一个群体逐渐习惯的东西。

items.example: Old French costume meant practice before it meant dress.
items.exampleCN: 古法语 costume 先指做法，后指服装。

items.example: Custom kept the social sense and lost the clothing sense.
items.exampleCN: custom 保留了社会义，丢掉了服装义。

items.example: Customary acts are the ones the phrase collects.
items.exampleCN: 按习俗的行为正是这个短语所汇集的对象。

items.structure: custom + -er, from the sense of habitual use
items.example: A customer was once simply a person wont to come.
items.exampleCN: 顾客原只是习惯于常来的人。

definition_zh: 共价的；由原子共享电子对而形成的
definition_en: describing a bond in which two atoms share one or more pairs of electrons
core_image: 两只手各伸出一半，握住同一根绳，绳由两边共同持有
scene: 两个人各用一只手握住同一根绳的中段，绳身由两边共同持有。 Two atoms share a pair of electrons in a covalent bond.
sceneCN: 这里 covalent 指原子共享电子对而形成键的（第 1 个义项：以共享电子对为特征的键合）；句意：在共价键中两个原子共享一对电子。图中可辨识物件：一根绳、两只手、共同握住的绳段、绷紧的绳尾。

senses.title: Sharing electrons in a bond
senses.definition: describing a bond formed by two atoms sharing one or more pairs of electrons
senses.definitionCN: 指两个原子共享一对或多对电子而形成的键
senses.example: Two atoms share a pair of electrons in a covalent bond.
senses.exampleCN: 在共价键中两个原子共享一对电子。
senses.why: co- means together and the stem means strength or worth, so the word says that the two atoms hold the link jointly.
senses.whyCN: 前缀表示「共同」，词干表示「力量、价值」，因此这个词说的是两个原子共同持有这条连接。

senses.title: Of a covalently bonded compound
senses.titleCN: 由共价键构成的化合物
senses.definition: describing a compound whose atoms are joined mainly by shared-electron bonds
senses.definitionCN: 指原子主要由共享电子键连接的化合物
senses.example: Carbon dioxide is a covalent compound with no ions in it.
senses.exampleCN: 二氧化碳是一种共价化合物，其中没有离子。
senses.why: the adjective transferred from the bond to the whole substance that such bonds build.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词从键转移到由这类键构成的整个物质。

senses.title: Covalent radius
senses.definition: describing the share of a bond length assigned to one atom when two atoms are joined covalently
senses.definitionCN: 指共价相连时分配给单个原子的那部分键长
senses.example: The covalent radius of chlorine is smaller than that of bromine.
senses.exampleCN: 氯的共价半径小于溴的共价半径。
senses.why: once bond lengths were measured, a half-length could be assigned to each atom, and the adjective marked that convention.
senses.whyCN: 键长可测之后，便可把一半长度分配给每个原子，这个形容词标记的正是这一约定。

senses.title: Covalent crystal
senses.definition: describing a solid held together in three dimensions by a continuous network of shared-electron bonds
senses.definitionCN: 指由共享电子键的连续网络在三维上维系的固体
senses.example: Diamond is a covalent crystal, which is why it scratches almost anything.
senses.exampleCN: 金刚石是共价晶体，所以它几乎能划伤任何东西。
senses.why: when the same bond repeats through a whole solid, the adjective moves from one link to the entire lattice.
senses.whyCN: 当同一种键贯穿整块固体重复出现，这个形容词便从一条连接转到整个晶格。

senses.title: Covalent modification in biochemistry
senses.titleCN: 生物化学中的共价修饰
senses.definition: describing a permanent chemical attachment of a group to a molecule, as in enzyme regulation
senses.definitionCN: 指某基团被化学性地永久接到分子上，如酶活性调节
senses.example: Phosphorylation is a covalent modification that switches the enzyme on.
senses.exampleCN: 磷酸化是一种共价修饰，能开启这种酶。
senses.why: biology borrowed the adjective for changes made by forming a real bond rather than by weak association.
senses.whyCN: 生物学借这个形容词指通过形成真实键、而非弱结合所造成的改变。

senses.title: Covalent catalysis
senses.definition: describing an enzyme mechanism in which a temporary covalent bond forms between enzyme and substrate
senses.definitionCN: 指酶与底物暂时形成共价键的催化机制
senses.example: The protease uses covalent catalysis to cut the peptide chain.
senses.exampleCN: 这种蛋白酶通过共价催化切断肽链。
senses.why: the mechanism is named by the kind of bond it uses, an ordinary extension of the adjective into a technique.
senses.whyCN: 这种机制以它所用的键型命名，是形容词向技术名称的普通延伸。

senses.title: Covalent cross-linking
senses.definition: describing permanent links formed between polymer chains to fix a network in place
senses.definitionCN: 指聚合物链之间形成的永久连接，使网络固定
senses.example: Covalent cross-linking makes the hydrogel keep its shape in water.
senses.exampleCN: 共价交联使水凝胶在水中保持形状。
senses.why: materials science describes a network by the kind of links that hold it, so the adjective precedes the joining.
senses.whyCN: 材料科学以维系网络的连接种类来描述网络，因此这个形容词放在「连接」之前。

senses.title: Covalent character in a bond
senses.definition: describing the degree to which a bond that is formally ionic still shares electrons
senses.definitionCN: 指形式上是离子键、实际仍共享电子的程度
senses.example: The bond in hydrogen chloride has substantial covalent character.
senses.exampleCN: 氯化氢中的键有相当大的共价成分。
senses.why: since real bonds fall between two extremes, the adjective became a measure of how far a bond leans toward sharing.
senses.whyCN: 由于真实的键处在两个极端之间，这个形容词便成为衡量键偏向共享程度的量。

intro.en: Covalent is a modern compound of co-, from Latin com-, together, and valent, from Latin valens, being strong or being worth. It was coined in English in the early twentieth century. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: covalent 是现代复合词，由 co-（出自拉丁 com-「共同」）与 valent（出自拉丁 valens「有力量、有价值」）构成。它在 20 世纪初由英语造出。年代均为约数。

items.en: Valere meant to be strong, to be well, to be worth; it also supplied value and valid. Its Indo-European connections are reconstructions.
items.cn: valere 意为「有力量、健康、有价值」，还给出 value 与 valid。它的印欧语联系属于重构。

items.en: The present participle valens, strong or worth, produced English words in -valent and the noun valentia, strength or capacity.
items.cn: 现在分词 valens「有力量的、有价值的」产生了英语中以 -valent 结尾的词，以及名词 valentia「力量、容量」。

items.en: Com-, together, assimilates to co- before vowels and to col-, cor- and con- before certain consonants, a pattern visible across the family.
items.cn: com-「共同」在元音前同化为 co-，在某些辅音前同化为 col-、cor-、con-，这一模式在整个词族中可见。

items.en: Nineteenth-century chemistry took valence from Latin valentia for the combining capacity of an atom, the quantity that covalent later qualified.
items.cn: 19 世纪的化学从拉丁 valentia 取来 valence，指原子的化合能力，也就是 covalent 后来所限定的那个量。

items.en: Covalent and covalence were coined in the early twentieth century, when chemists needed a word for bonds based on shared electrons; the term is recorded from 1919.
items.cn: covalent 与 covalence 于 20 世纪初被造出，当时化学家需要一个词来指以共享电子为基础的键；该词自 1919 年有记录。

items.en: First date uncertain: the coinage belongs to the early twentieth century, but the earliest printed use is not fully settled, so the date given is approximate.
items.cn: 首见年代不确定：这个新造词属于 20 世纪初，但最早的印刷用例尚无完全定论，因此给出的年代只是约数。

note.en: The first group shares the valere stem and is easily mixed up; the second group names the other bond types and the qualities used to contrast them.
note.cn: 第一组共享 valere 词干，极易混淆；第二组是其他键型以及用于对照的性质。

entries.definition: The noun for the sharing itself; covalent is the adjective that describes a bond of this kind.
entries.definitionCN: 指「共享」这一性质的名词；covalent 是描述这类键的形容词。

entries.definition: The combining capacity of an atom, a number; sharing electrons is one way of satisfying it, not the same thing.
entries.definitionCN: 指原子的化合能力，是一个数；共享电子是满足它的一种方式，并不等同。

entries.definition: The British variant of valence; it is a count, while covalent describes the kind of link.
entries.definitionCN: valence 的英式变体；它是计数，而 covalent 描述连接种类。

entries.definition: Also from valere, but it describes bravery rather than combining power; the shared root does not make it a chemistry word.
entries.definitionCN: 同样出自 valere，但描述勇敢而非化合能力；共享词根并不使它成为化学词。

entries.definition: Describing bonds made by electron transfer and electrostatic attraction, the usual opposite of covalent in teaching.
entries.definitionCN: 描述由电子转移与静电吸引形成的键，在教学中通常是 covalent 的对照项。

entries.definition: Describing the shared-electron sea of metals, a third arrangement beside covalent and ionic.
entries.definitionCN: 描述金属共享电子海的结构，是与共价、离子并列的第三种安排。

entries.definition: Describing a covalent bond whose electrons are shared unequally; it is a variety of covalent, not its opposite.
entries.definitionCN: 描述电子共享不均的共价键；它是共价的一种，而非其反面。

entries.definition: Describing matter made of molecules, which covalent bonds commonly build; it names the product, not the link.
entries.definitionCN: 描述由分子构成的物质，共价键常构成这类物质；它命名产物，而非连接。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real Latin verb, the real prefix pattern and real laboratory phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的拉丁动词、真实的前缀同化模式与真实的实验室说法。

normal.en: Co- together plus valent strength: two atoms hold the bond jointly, each contributing an electron.
normal.cn: co-「共同」加 valent「力量」：两个原子共同持有这条键，各自出一个电子。

normal.en: The family runs covalent, covalence, covalently, valence and valency.
normal.cn: 同族词有 covalent、covalence、covalently、valence 与 valency。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the applications: covalent bond, covalent crystal, covalent modification.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出应用：共价键、共价晶体、共价修饰。

normal.en: Co- is the assimilated form of com-, the same prefix heard in cooperate and connect.
normal.cn: co- 是 com- 的同化形式，与 cooperate、connect 中的前缀相同。

normal.en: Covalent and ionic are taught as a pair: sharing against transferring.
normal.cn: covalent 与 ionic 总成对教授：共享对转移。

abstract.en: Picture two hands on one rope, neither letting go.
abstract.cn: 想象两只手握着同一根绳，谁都不松。

abstract.en: Picture a pair of dancers who own the same step between them.
abstract.cn: 想象一对舞者，彼此之间共有同一个舞步。

abstract.en: Picture a fence whose two owners both pay for the same post.
abstract.cn: 想象一道篱笆，两户人家都为同一根柱子出钱。

examples.en: Water molecules are held together by polar covalent bonds.
examples.cn: 水分子由极性共价键维系在一起。

examples.en: The two elements form a covalent compound rather than a salt.
examples.cn: 这两种元素形成共价化合物，而不是盐。

examples.en: Enzymes often make a temporary covalent intermediate.
examples.cn: 酶常常形成暂时的共价中间体。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「co（共同）+ valent（力量）」——两边共同出力握住同一条键 → 共价的

root: 拉丁 valere「有力量、有价值」→ valens「有力量的」→ valentia「力量、容量」→ 英语 valence「化合价」；加 com-（同化为 co-「共同」）→ 20 世纪初造出 covalent「共价的」。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one arrangement: two atoms hold the same electrons between them. The arrangement then names a compound, a radius, a crystal, a biochemical attachment, a catalytic trick, a cross-link and finally the degree of sharing inside an ionic bond.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一种安排展开：两个原子在彼此之间共同持有同一对电子。这种安排随后命名一种化合物、一种半径、一种晶体、一种生化连接、一种催化手法、一种交联，最后是离子键内部的共享程度。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two hands gripping the middle of one rope, so that neither holds it alone.
core.cn: 核心意象：两只手各握住一根绳的中段，谁也不是独自持有。

branches.en: THE SHARING ITSELF: one pair of electrons belongs to two atoms at once.
branches.cn: 共享本身：一对电子同时属于两个原子。

branches.en: THE SUBSTANCE: a whole compound built by such sharing, with no ions.
branches.cn: 物质：由这种共享构成、不含离子的整个化合物。

branches.en: MEASURE AND REPEAT: half a bond length becomes a radius, and a repeated bond becomes a crystal.
branches.cn: 测量与重复：半个键长成为半径，重复的键成为晶体。

branches.en: PERMANENT ATTACHMENT: groups fixed onto molecules, and chains locked into a network.
branches.cn: 永久连接：基团被固定到分子上，链被锁进网络。

branches.en: MECHANISM AND DEGREE: a temporary bond used by an enzyme, and how much sharing an ionic bond really has.
branches.cn: 机理与程度：酶所用的暂时键，以及离子键实际的共享程度。

intro.en: Covalent is a textbook modern compound: a Latin prefix, a Latin participle stem and an English ending, all transparent.
intro.cn: covalent 是教科书式的现代复合词：拉丁前缀、拉丁分词词干与英语词尾，全都透明可读。

latinIntro.en: Latin valere and valens supply the stem, and com- supplies the prefix; no single Latin word covalent exists, because the compound was made in English.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 valere 与 valens 提供词干，com- 提供前缀；拉丁语中并不存在 covalent 这一单词，因为它是英语造的复合词。

items.example: The prefix says the two atoms hold the link jointly.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀说明两个原子共同持有这条键。

items.structure: valere, valui, valitum (Latin verb, second conjugation)
items.example: The verb supplies the idea of capacity or worth.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词提供「容量、价值」的意思。

items.example: The participle is the source of the -valent ending.
items.exampleCN: 这个分词是 -valent 词尾的来源。

items.example: The noun became the chemical term for combining capacity.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词成了表示化合能力的化学术语。

items.structure: valentia through French and German chemistry
items.example: Carbon has a valence of four in most compounds.
items.exampleCN: 碳在多数化合物中化合价为四。

items.example: A covalent bond holds the two hydrogen atoms together.
items.exampleCN: 一条共价键把两个氢原子结合在一起。

items.example: Covalence is the noun behind the adjective.
items.exampleCN: covalence 是形容词背后的名词。

items.example: The drug is covalently attached to the protein.
items.exampleCN: 这种药以共价方式接到蛋白质上。

items.example: Valency is counted in bonds, not in electrons alone.
items.exampleCN: 化合价按键计数，而不只是按电子计数。

items.example: Ionic and covalent bonds are taught as two extremes.
items.exampleCN: 离子键与共价键被当作两个极端来教。

definition_zh: 绩效评估；性能评测；表现评价
definition_en: a formal judgement of how well a person, a machine or an activity has done against agreed standards
core_image: 年终考评的会议室里，主管在评分表上逐项打分，旁边的投影显示着全年产出曲线
scene: 年终考评会上，主管对照评分表逐项记下每个人这一年的产出与协作情况。 The annual performance evaluation compares each worker's output with agreed targets.
sceneCN: 句中的说法指「对照既定目标判断工作成效的正式评估」（第 1 个义项：对员工年度工作成果的正式评定）；句意为年度绩效评估把每位员工的产出与商定目标作比较。图中可辨识物件：评分表、产出曲线、会议桌、签字笔。

pos.zh: 绩效评估（可数名词短语）
性能评测；表现评价（可数名词短语）

derivatives.zh: 表现不佳；业绩低于预期

senses.title: A formal judgement of a worker's year
senses.definition: the periodic review in which a manager rates an employee's results against set goals
senses.definitionCN: 主管对照既定目标，定期评定员工业绩的程序
senses.example: The annual performance evaluation compares each worker's output with agreed targets.
senses.exampleCN: 年度绩效评估把每位员工的产出与商定目标作比较。
senses.why: Performance here means how well someone carried out the job, and evaluation means fixing its worth, so the phrase is a judgement of work done.
senses.whyCN: 这里的前一个词指工作执行得如何，后一个词指判定其价值，因此这个短语就是对已完成工作的评判。

senses.title: A test of how well a machine works
senses.definition: a measured assessment of the speed, accuracy or efficiency of a device under stated conditions
senses.definitionCN: 在规定条件下对装置速度、精度或效率的测量评定
senses.example: A performance evaluation of the new pump showed a ten percent gain.
senses.exampleCN: 对新泵的性能评测显示效率提高了百分之十。
senses.why: Machines also perform, so the same phrase moved from people to equipment and now means a bench test.
senses.whyCN: 机器也在「表现」，因此同一短语从人转到设备，如今指台架测试。

senses.title: A review of whether a project met its aims
senses.definition: an assessment of a programme's delivery against its plan, often required by funders
senses.definitionCN: 对照计划评定某项目的交付情况，常由出资方要求
senses.example: The donors asked for a performance evaluation halfway through the project.
senses.exampleCN: 出资方要求在项目进行到一半时做一次执行评估。
senses.why: A project performs in the sense of delivering, so its mid-course review took the same name as a staff appraisal.
senses.whyCN: 项目在「交付」意义上也在表现，因此其中期评审与员工考核用了同一名称。

senses.title: An assessment of a student's demonstrated work
senses.definition: a judgement based on what a learner actually produces rather than on a single test score
senses.definitionCN: 依据学习者实际完成的成果而非单次考试分数作出的评定
senses.example: Teachers use a performance evaluation rubric rather than a single test score.
senses.exampleCN: 教师用表现评价量表，而不是只看一次考试分数。
senses.why: Education borrowed the phrase to separate what a student does from what a test measures, and a rubric makes the judgement explicit.
senses.whyCN: 教育借这个短语把学生实际做到的事与考试测到的东西分开，评分量表使这种判断明确可见。

senses.title: A review of an organization's results
senses.titleCN: 组织或子公司业绩评估
senses.definition: a formal judgement of how a division or subsidiary has performed over a period
senses.definitionCN: 对某部门或子公司在某一时期业绩的正式评定
senses.example: The board's performance evaluation of the subsidiary led to a sale.
senses.exampleCN: 董事会对该子公司的业绩评估最终导致将其出售。
senses.why: Whole units are judged by results too, so the phrase scales from one worker to an entire company.
senses.whyCN: 整个单位也按结果受评，因此这个短语可以从一名员工扩展到一整家公司。

senses.title: A benchmark of a model or algorithm
senses.definition: a measured comparison of a system's accuracy, speed or cost on a fixed set of tasks
senses.definitionCN: 在固定任务集上对系统准确率、速度或成本的测量比较
senses.example: The team ran a performance evaluation of three speech models on the same data.
senses.exampleCN: 团队在同一批数据上对三个语音模型做了性能评估。
senses.why: Software performs on tasks, so testing it against a fixed set became another performance evaluation.
senses.whyCN: 软件在任务上「表现」，因此在固定任务集上测试它，又成了一种性能评估。

senses.title: The measurement of actual language use
senses.definition: in linguistics, the study of real utterances rather than of the underlying knowledge that produces them
senses.definitionCN: 语言学中研究实际说出的话语，而非产生话语的底层知识
senses.example: A performance evaluation in linguistics looks at actual utterances rather than idealized knowledge.
senses.exampleCN: 语言学中的运用评估考察实际说出的话语，而非理想化的知识。
senses.why: The field separates competence from performance, and measuring the latter is literally evaluating how language is performed.
senses.whyCN: 该学科把语言能力与语言运用分开，测量后者字面上就是评估语言被运用的情形。

senses.title: A judgement of athletic execution
senses.definition: a technical review of how a movement was executed, often from video
senses.definitionCN: 对某一动作完成质量的技术性评审，常借助录像
senses.example: Coaches video each sprint for a performance evaluation of technique.
senses.exampleCN: 教练为每次冲刺录像，用来做技术表现评估。
senses.why: Sport performs before an audience, so the review of technique inherited the word from the stage as much as from the office.
senses.whyCN: 运动在观众面前「表现」，因此对技术的评审既承自办公室，也承自舞台。

intro.en: The phrase joins a verb of carrying something through to a noun of worth. Performance came through Old French from a verb meaning to complete; evaluation came from French and rests on a Latin verb meaning to be worth. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: 这个短语把一个表示「把事做完」的动词与一个表示「价值」的名词连在一起。前者经古法语出自意为「完成」的动词；后者来自法语，底子是拉丁语中表示「有价值」的动词。年代均为约数。

items.en: Par- 'thoroughly' plus fournir 'to provide' produced parfournir 'to carry out to the end, to complete'. The origin of fournir is uncertain, possibly Germanic.
items.cn: par-「彻底」加 fournir「提供」构成 parfournir，意为「做到最后、完成」。fournir 的来源不确定，可能出自日耳曼语。

items.en: Valere meant 'to be strong, to be well, to be worth'. Its deeper origin is a reconstruction, so source uncertain below Latin.
items.cn: valere 意为「强壮、健康、有价值」。其更深来源属重构形式，故拉丁语以下来源不确定。

items.en: French évaluer 'to fix the value of' was formed on value, and English evaluation entered in the nineteenth century.
items.cn: 法语中表示「确定价值」的动词由「价值」构成，这个词于十九世纪进入英语。

items.en: Performance first meant the carrying out of a task or the giving of a play, and only later the measured efficiency of a machine.
items.cn: 这个词最初指任务的完成或戏剧的演出，后来才指机器的实测效率。

items.en: Personnel management joined the two words in the twentieth century, and the phrase spread to equipment, projects and models.
items.cn: 二十世纪人事管理把这两个词连在一起，此后该短语扩及设备、项目与模型。

note.en: Group one holds phrases that share one of the two words but judge a different thing; group two holds single words for judging worth or performance.
note.cn: 第一组是共用其中一个词、但评判对象不同的短语；第二组是表示评判价值或表现的单字词。

entries.definition: The human-resources term for the same staff review; appraisal stresses the interview and the rating form.
entries.definitionCN: 人力资源领域对同一种员工考核的叫法，更强调面谈与评分表。

entries.definition: A periodic look back at results; it may be informal and need not produce a score.
entries.definitionCN: 定期回顾成果，可以是非正式的，未必给出分数。

entries.definition: The continuing system of goals, feedback and rewards, of which one evaluation is a step.
entries.definitionCN: 目标、反馈与奖励的持续体系，单次评估只是其中一步。

entries.definition: A measure that signals how well something is going; it feeds an evaluation but is not one.
entries.definitionCN: 指示运行状况的指标，供评估使用，但本身不是评估。

entries.definition: A judgement of the level or quality reached, often broader than one person's yearly results.
entries.definitionCN: 对达到的水平或质量所作判断，范围常比一名员工的年度成果更宽。

entries.definition: A judgement of value, used for property, staff and projects alike.
entries.definitionCN: 对价值的判定，可用于房产、员工与项目。

entries.definition: A formal check of accounts or compliance against rules, not of how well work was done.
entries.definitionCN: 对账目或合规情况的正式核查，而非评断工作做得好不好。

entries.definition: A standard against which results are compared; it supplies the yardstick rather than the verdict.
entries.definitionCN: 用来比较结果的标准，提供尺子而不给出结论。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: The first word names how a task was carried out; the second names the act of fixing its worth.
normal.cn: 前一个词指任务执行得如何，后一个词指判定其价值的动作。

normal.en: One family runs perform, performance, performer and underperform; the other runs value, evaluate, evaluation and evaluator.
normal.cn: 一族是同出「执行」的词，另一族是同出「价值」的词。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the setting: annual performance evaluation, evaluation criteria, evaluation report.
normal.cn: 固定说法标出场景：年度绩效评估、评估标准、评估报告。

normal.en: The phrase moves from staff to pumps, projects, students, models and sprinters, because all of them perform.
normal.cn: 这个短语从员工转到泵、项目、学生、模型与短跑者，因为它们都在「表现」。

normal.en: An indicator is a number; an evaluation is a judgement made with that number.
normal.cn: 指标是一个数字；评估是用这个数字作出的判断。

abstract.en: Picture a form with boxes, and a pen that hesitates before the last one.
abstract.cn: 想象一张带格子的表格，笔在最后一格前停了一停。

abstract.en: Picture two runners and one stopwatch shared between them.
abstract.cn: 想象两名跑者和一只两人共用的秒表。

abstract.en: Picture a mirror that reports not what you look like but how far you have come.
abstract.cn: 想象一面镜子，照出的不是你的样子，而是你走了多远。

examples.en: The union objected that the performance evaluation rewarded speed over safety.
examples.cn: 工会反对说，绩效评估奖励速度而轻视安全。

examples.en: A performance evaluation of the battery pack is due before winter.
examples.cn: 电池组的性能评测要在入冬前完成。

examples.en: Without a performance evaluation, the grant cannot be renewed.
examples.cn: 没有执行评估，这笔资助就无法续期。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「performance（表现）+ evaluation（评估）」——看表现再打分 → 绩效评估、性能评测

root: 这个短语的前半经古法语出自意为「做到最后」的动词，由「彻底」前缀加「提供」动词构成，后者来源不确定；后半经法语出自「价值」，再上溯拉丁语表示「有价值、强壮」的动词，其更早词根为重构形式。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one act of judging: a worker's year is rated, a machine is bench-tested, a project is reviewed, a student's work is scored, a subsidiary is judged, a model is benchmarked, actual language use is measured, and a movement is filmed and graded.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一个评判动作展开：评员工一年、试机器性能、审项目交付、给学生成果打分、判子公司业绩、给模型做基准、测实际语言运用，最后给一个动作录像评分。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a ratings sheet on a meeting table, every row compared with a target written in the same column.
core.cn: 核心意象：会议桌上的一张评分表，每一行都与同一列写着的目标对照。

branches.en: JUDGING PEOPLE: a worker's year and a student's work are rated by what was actually produced.
branches.cn: 评判人：员工的一年与学生的成果，都按实际产出评定。

branches.en: JUDGING EXECUTION: a pump on a bench and a sprint on video are both measured for how well they ran.
branches.cn: 评判执行：台架上的泵与录像里的冲刺，都在测它们运行得多好。

branches.en: JUDGING A WHOLE EFFORT: a project and a subsidiary are assessed against a plan and a target.
branches.cn: 评判整体：项目与子公司都对照计划与目标受评。

branches.en: JUDGING A MODEL: a fixed task set turns performance into a number to compare.
branches.cn: 评判模型：固定任务集把表现变成一个可比较的数字。

branches.en: JUDGING USE: linguistics measures utterances rather than the knowledge behind them.

intro.en: The phrase is built from two histories: a French verb of completing a task and a Latin-rooted noun of worth, each with its own family.
intro.cn: 这个短语由两段历史构成：一个法语来源、表示「完成任务」的动词，以及一个拉丁词根、表示「价值」的名词，各自带一族词。

latinIntro.en: Latin valere gives value, evaluate, evaluation and valuable; the French verb behind perform gives performance and performer.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语中表示「有价值」的动词衍生出价值与评估等词；表示「完成」的法语动词则衍生出表现与表演者。

items.example: The source verb is French, and its own origin is uncertain.

definition_zh: 丑角；滑稽可笑的人；粗俗的逗乐者
definition_en: a ridiculous person who clowns about to amuse others
core_image: 翻着跟头的小丑，动作夸张惹人笑
scene: 宴会上他做鬼脸、学鹅走路，把满座逗得前仰后合。 The guest acted like a buffoon to keep everyone laughing.
sceneCN: 这里 buffoon 是「丑角、滑稽可笑的人」（第 1 个义项：以夸张滑稽举动逗乐）；句意是这位客人扮丑逗众人发笑。

pos.zh: 丑角；小丑；滑稽粗俗的逗乐者

senses.title: A comic performer
senses.definition: a performer who amuses by exaggerated gestures, pratfalls and jokes
senses.definitionCN: 以夸张动作、摔跤和笑话逗人发笑的表演者
senses.example: The medieval court kept a buffoon to entertain the king.
senses.exampleCN: 中世纪宫廷养着弄臣为国王取乐。
senses.why: The Italian source names a trotting dance; a prancing figure became the comic type.
senses.whyCN: 意大利语源词指一种蹦跳的舞，蹦蹦跳跳的身影遂定型为滑稽角色。

senses.title: A ridiculous person
senses.definition: a person whose behavior is absurd and merits ridicule
senses.definitionCN: 言行荒唐、令人嘲弄的人
senses.example: He made a buffoon of himself at the debate.
senses.exampleCN: 他在辩论中出尽了洋相。
senses.why: What begins as deliberate clowning ends as unintentional self-ridicule.
senses.whyCN: 从刻意的插科打诨滑向无意的自取其辱，义项由扮演转为品评。

senses.title: A vulgar jester
senses.definition: one who amuses with coarse, undignified antics
senses.definitionCN: 以粗鄙、有失体统的举动逗乐的人
senses.example: Critics called the satire vulgar buffoonery.
senses.exampleCN: 评论家称这种讽刺是粗俗的滑稽把戏。
senses.why: Low comedy was long despised as beneath refined art.
senses.whyCN: 低级滑稽历来被雅艺术轻视，义项带上了贬抑的道德色彩。

intro.en: Buffoon traveled from Italian through French into English, keeping a dance at its core.
intro.cn: buffoon 经由法语自意大利语传入英语，词核始终是一种舞蹈。

items.en: buffare meant to puff; buffone named a prancing jester, from a trotting dance.
items.cn: 意大利语 buffare 义为喷气，buffone 指一种蹦跳舞的滑稽角色。

items.en: bouffon kept the sense of a grotesque comic figure.
items.cn: 法语 bouffon 保留了怪诞滑稽角色之义。

items.en: buffoon entered English for court jesters and low comics.
items.cn: 十六至十七世纪 buffoon 进入英语，指宫廷弄臣与低俗滑稽演员。

items.en: buffoonery and buffoonish spread the word through moralistic criticism.
items.cn: buffoonery、buffoonish 随道德批评流行开来。

items.en: buffoon now mocks any public figure acting ridiculously.
items.cn: 如今 buffoon 用以讥讽任何举止荒唐的公众人物。

definition_zh: adj. 勇敢的，有胆量的
definition_en: brave enough to face danger or pain

sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：courageous 指勇敢的；句意是他足够勇敢，独自公开发言。

senses.title: Facing danger
senses.definition: able to face danger without backing away

definition_zh: 谐音的；元音韵的；音似的
definition_en: having or showing assonance; having similar vowel sounds

scene: 她把两行诗并排写在黑板上，圈出彼此呼应的元音字母。 The assonant vowels in those lines give the verse its music.
sceneCN: 这里 assonant 是「谐音的」（第 1 个义项：元音相似的）；句意为这些诗行里谐和的元音赋予诗句音乐感。

definition_zh: 岩浆；地下熔融岩石；岩浆房；岩浆类型（玄武质、花岗质）；行星岩浆洋；泛指熔融物质；比喻压抑的强烈情绪或力量
definition_en: molten rock stored beneath the surface of a planet, which may cool to form igneous rock or reach the surface as lava
core_image: 地表之下极深处，一汪橙红的黏稠熔体在岩壁间缓慢翻滚，被上方厚重的岩层死死压住
scene: 钻探船的甲板上，仪器显示地下深处有一层缓慢流动的高温熔体，压力正在上升。 Scientists drill into the ocean floor to sample the magma before it reaches the surface.
sceneCN: 这里 magma 指仍在地下的熔融岩石（第 1 个义项：位于地表之下、尚未喷出的熔融态岩石）；句意为科学家钻入海底，在岩浆到达地表之前取样。

pos.zh: 岩浆体（如岩浆房、岩浆洋）
泛指熔融物质；比喻压抑的强烈情绪或力量

derivatives.zh: 岩浆的；与岩浆作用有关的
岩浆学（较少见的学科名称）
岩浆房（复合术语，指储存岩浆的地下腔体）
岩浆洋（复合术语，指行星早期的全球性熔融层）

senses.title: Molten rock underground
senses.definition: molten or partly molten rock stored beneath the surface of a planet
senses.definitionCN: 储存于行星地表之下、呈熔融或半熔融状态的岩石
senses.example: The magma rose slowly through a network of cracks.
senses.exampleCN: 岩浆沿着裂隙网络缓慢上升。
senses.why: Greek magma meant a kneaded mass; geologists applied it to rock softened by heat into a paste-like body.
senses.whyCN: 希腊 magma 意为「揉成的团块」；地质学家用它指被热软化成糊状团块的岩石。

senses.title: A chamber that stores magma
senses.definition: a large body of magma held within the crust, often feeding a volcano
senses.definitionCN: 地壳中储存大量岩浆的腔体，常为火山提供补给
senses.example: Seismic surveys revealed a magma chamber three kilometres below the summit.
senses.exampleCN: 地震勘测显示峰顶下方三公里处有一个岩浆房。
senses.why: the mass had to be located somewhere, so the container sense grew out of the material sense.
senses.whyCN: 这团熔体总得存在于某处，于是「容器」义从「材料」义中生长出来。

senses.title: Magma typed by composition
senses.titleCN: 按成分划分的岩浆类型
senses.definition: a melt described by its chemical composition, such as basaltic or granitic magma
senses.definitionCN: 按化学成分描述的熔体，如玄武质岩浆或花岗质岩浆
senses.example: Basaltic magma is hotter and runnier than granitic melt.
senses.exampleCN: 玄武质岩浆比花岗质熔体更热、更稀。
senses.why: composition decides how a melt behaves, so the word came to name varieties rather than one substance.
senses.whyCN: 成分决定熔体的行为，因此这个词开始指称不同品种，而非单一物质。

senses.title: Any molten material
senses.definition: a general term for a hot melt, including molten metal, glass or ice
senses.definitionCN: 对高温熔体的泛称，包括熔融金属、玻璃或冰
senses.example: The furnace stirred a magma of molten glass and ash.
senses.exampleCN: 炉中翻搅着一团熔融玻璃与灰的混合物。
senses.why: the paste image is broad enough to cover industrial and planetary melts that are not rock.
senses.whyCN: 「糊状团块」的意象足够宽，可覆盖并非岩石的工业熔体与行星熔体。

senses.title: A planet-wide magma ocean
senses.definition: a global layer of molten rock on a young planet or moon
senses.definitionCN: 年轻行星或卫星上全球性的熔融岩石层
senses.example: The early Moon probably had a magma ocean hundreds of kilometres deep.
senses.exampleCN: 早期的月球可能有一层深达数百公里的岩浆洋。
senses.why: planetary science extended the underground body to the whole surface of a young world.
senses.whyCN: 行星科学把地下的熔体扩展到年轻天体的整个表面。

senses.title: Mixing of two magmas
senses.definition: the process in which two different magmas meet and blend, often before an eruption
senses.definitionCN: 两种不同岩浆相遇并混合的过程，常发生在喷发之前
senses.example: Textures in the lava record magma mixing just before the blast.
senses.exampleCN: 熔岩中的结构记录了爆发前一刻的岩浆混合。
senses.why: the word works as an attributive noun here, so the compound can name a process between two bodies of melt.
senses.whyCN: 在这个复合术语中该词作定语名词，因此整个复合词能指两团熔体之间的过程。

senses.title: The parent magma
senses.definition: the original melt from which a series of related rocks or melts are derived
senses.definitionCN: 一系列相关岩石或熔体所由衍生的原始熔体
senses.example: Geochemists traced all the samples back to one parental magma.
senses.exampleCN: 地球化学家把全部样品追溯至同一个母岩浆。
senses.why: the word works as a family term, with melts descending from a common source as children from a parent.
senses.whyCN: 该词被当作家族术语：各熔体如同子女，源自同一个母体。

senses.title: Suppressed fury like magma
senses.definition: a figurative use for strong feeling or power that is held down and may break out
senses.definitionCN: 比喻被压住、可能冲破而出的强烈情绪或力量
senses.example: Resentment had been gathering like magma beneath the quiet office.
senses.exampleCN: 怨气像岩浆一样在那间安静的办公室里积攒。
senses.why: magma is invisible and dangerous precisely because it is still under the crust, which makes it a natural image for held-in anger.
senses.whyCN: 岩浆之所以危险，正因为它仍在壳下、看不见，这使它成为压抑怒气的天然意象。

intro.en: Magma comes from Greek magma, a kneaded mass, from massein, to knead. Latin used magma only as a Greek loanword, so there is no native Latin family behind it. Geology adopted the term in the nineteenth century for molten rock still underground, specifically to contrast with lava at the surface.
intro.cn: magma 一般认为源自希腊 magma「揉成的团块」，出自动词 massein「揉、捏」，但更早的前希腊词根并不确定。拉丁语中的 magma 只是希腊借词，背后没有本土拉丁词族。地质学在十九世纪采用该词指仍在地下的熔融岩石，特意与已到地表的 lava 相对。

items.en: Massein meant to knead, press or work a soft substance with the hands.
items.cn: massein 意为「揉、压」，用手把柔软之物反复捏合。

items.en: Magma was the result: a kneaded mass, and in medical Greek a thick ointment or paste.
items.cn: magma 是结果：揉成的一团；在希腊医学中还指浓稠的药膏或糊剂。

items.en: Latin texts used magma as an unassimilated Greek word. It has no Latin verb or noun relatives, which is why this entry leaves the Latin list empty.
items.cn: 拉丁文献把 magma 当作未同化的希腊词使用。它没有拉丁动词或名词同族，因此本词条的拉丁词表留空。

items.en: Nineteenth-century geology needed a word for melt that had not yet reached the surface; magma filled that gap.
items.cn: 十九世纪的地质学需要一个词指尚未到达地表的熔体，magma 正好补上这个空位。

items.en: The word now covers magma chambers, magma oceans, magma mixing and parental magma, and is also used figuratively.
items.cn: 这个词如今覆盖岩浆房、岩浆洋、岩浆混合与母岩浆，也被用于比喻。

items.en: Source uncertain (root in doubt): the Greek origin is generally accepted, from magma, a kneaded mass, and massein, to knead; but the deeper pre-Greek root of massein is unsettled, any older form offered for it is a reconstruction, and the exact date of the geological sense is approximate.
items.cn: 来源不确定（词根存疑）：一般认为是希腊 magma「揉成的团块」，出自 massein「揉、捏」，这一路径获较广泛接受；但 massein 更早的前希腊词根并无定论，凡给出的更深形式均属重构形式，地质义的确切首见年代亦为约数。

note.en: Group one holds forms built on the same word; group two holds the terms most often confused with magma.
note.cn: 第一组是由同一个词构成的形式；第二组是最容易与岩浆混淆的术语。

entries.definition: Relating to magma or to the processes that involve it, as in magmatic water or magmatic differentiation.
entries.definitionCN: 与岩浆或岩浆参与的过程有关，如岩浆水、岩浆分异。

entries.definition: The total activity of magma within a region, including its generation, movement and solidification.
entries.definitionCN: 一个区域内岩浆活动的总和，包括生成、运移与固结。

entries.definition: An uncommon plural modelled on Greek and Latin neuter plurals; magmas is the usual form.
entries.definitionCN: 模仿希腊语与拉丁语中性复数构成的少见复数；常用复数仍是 magmas。

entries.definition: The underground reservoir that holds magma; the phrase names the container, not the melt.
entries.definitionCN: 储存岩浆的地下储库；这个短语指容器，而非熔体本身。

entries.definition: The same molten rock once it has reached the surface; magma is the underground stage, lava the exposed stage.
entries.definitionCN: 同一种熔融岩石到达地表之后的名称；magma 是地下阶段，lava 是露出地表的阶段。

entries.definition: A plain description of rock heated until liquid; magma is the technical term for it underground.
entries.definitionCN: 对加热至液态的岩石的平实描述；magma 是它在地下时的术语。

entries.definition: In petrology, a synonym for liquid rock or the liquid portion of a partly molten system.
entries.definitionCN: 在岩石学中指液态岩石，或部分熔融体系中的液相部分。

entries.definition: Describing rock formed from cooled magma or lava; it names the product, not the molten stage.
entries.definitionCN: 描述由冷却的岩浆或熔岩形成的岩石；指产物，而非熔融阶段。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real Greek morphology, real collocations and the real magma-lava boundary.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的希腊构词、真实搭配，以及真实存在的岩浆与熔岩分界。

normal.en: Greek massein means to knead: magma is rock softened and worked into a glowing paste.
normal.cn: 希腊 massein 意为「揉」：岩浆就是被揉软、揉成一团的灼热糊状岩石。

normal.en: Magma stays below, lava comes out: one word for the hidden stage, one for the exposed stage.
normal.cn: 岩浆留在地下，熔岩流到地表：一个词指隐藏阶段，一个词指露出阶段。

normal.en: Compound terms come in a series: magma chamber, magma ocean, magma mixing, parental magma.
normal.cn: 复合术语成串出现：岩浆房、岩浆洋、岩浆混合、母岩浆。

normal.en: Composition splits it into basaltic magma and granitic magma, the first hotter and runnier.
normal.cn: 按成分可分为玄武质岩浆与花岗质岩浆，前者更热、更稀。

normal.en: The figurative use keeps the position: anger sits under the surface like magma under crust.
normal.cn: 比喻用法保留了位置：怒气伏在表面之下，如同壳下的岩浆。

abstract.en: Picture dough being folded and pressed in a bowl until it becomes one soft mass.
abstract.cn: 想象面团在盆里被反复折叠按压，最后成了一团柔软的整体。

abstract.en: Picture a thick soup held down by a lid, steam bubbling only at the rim.
abstract.cn: 想象一锅浓汤被盖子压住，热气只在边缘冒出细泡。

abstract.en: Picture a hidden underground river that makes the ground above slightly warm.
abstract.cn: 想象地下有一条看不见的暗河，让上方的地面微微发烫。

examples.en: The magma cooled slowly at depth, forming coarse crystals.
examples.cn: 岩浆在深处缓慢冷却，形成粗大的晶体。

examples.en: A magma chamber beneath the caldera was detected by seismic waves.
examples.cn: 地震波探测到破火山口下方有一个岩浆房。

examples.en: Her anger sat like magma, unseen until the day it broke through.
examples.cn: 她的怒气像岩浆一样伏着，直到爆发那天才被看见。

dict_mnemonic.text: 希腊语「揉成的团」——地热把岩石揉软，还压在地壳里 → 岩浆

root: 希腊 magma「揉成的团块」，出自 massein「揉、捏」；拉丁语仅作希腊借词使用，无本土同族；地质学借指地下熔融岩石，与地表的 lava（熔岩）分工。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one hidden body: a kneaded melt that sits under rock. The material sense comes first, then its container, its composition, the wider class of melts, planetary and process uses, a source term, and finally the figurative pressure it suggests.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项围绕同一个隐藏的物体：一团伏在岩石之下的熔体。先讲物质本身，再讲容器、成分、更宽的熔体类别、行星与过程用法、源熔体，最后落在它暗示的压抑之势。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a kneaded, glowing paste trapped under a lid of rock.
core.cn: 核心意象：一团被岩石盖子压住的灼热糊状物。

branches.en: MATERIAL AND CONTAINER: the melt itself, and the cavity that holds it.
branches.cn: 物质与容器：熔体本身，以及容纳它的腔体。

branches.en: COMPOSITION AND SOURCE: chemistry sorts the melt into types, and one type can be the parent of a rock series.
branches.cn: 成分与来源：化学把熔体分成类型，而某一类型可以成为一套岩石系列的母体。

branches.en: BEYOND ROCK: the same paste image covers industrial melts and a planet-wide molten layer.
branches.cn: 越出岩石：同一个糊状意象覆盖工业熔体与全球性的熔融层。

branches.en: PROCESS BETWEEN BODIES: two melts can meet and blend before an eruption.
branches.cn: 两团之间的过程：两股熔体可以在喷发前相遇并混合。

branches.en: FIGURATIVE PRESSURE: what is held under the crust becomes the image of held-in fury.
branches.cn: 比喻压力：压在壳下之物，成为被压抑怒气的意象。

intro.en: Magma is not built from Latin prefixes and suffixes; it is a whole Greek noun borrowed intact, so these items are stems and compounds rather than derivational endings.
intro.cn: magma 不是由拉丁前缀与后缀构成的，而是整体借入的希腊名词；因此下列条目是词干与复合形式，而非派生词尾。

latinIntro.en: Latin contributes no native relatives: magma appears only as a Greek loanword, and the geological vocabulary is built by compounding with English and Latin elements.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语没有提供本土同族词：magma 只作为希腊借词出现，地质词汇靠英语与拉丁成分复合构成。

items.example: The stem magma- appears unchanged in English.
items.exampleCN: 词干 magma- 在英语中保持原形。

items.example: Magmatic describes anything that belongs to magma.
items.exampleCN: magmatic 描述一切属于岩浆的事物。

items.structure: -ismos (Greek noun suffix of activity or system)
items.example: Magmatism names the activity of magma in a region.
items.exampleCN: magmatism 指一个区域内的岩浆活动。

items.example: Magmatology is the study of magmas and their evolution.
items.exampleCN: 岩浆学是研究岩浆及其演化的学问。

items.example: The chamber fed the eruption for several weeks.
items.exampleCN: 这个岩浆房为喷发供给了数周。

items.example: The magma ocean solidified from the top down.
Magma mixing can trigger an eruption.
items.exampleCN: 岩浆混合可能触发喷发。

items.meaning: source melt of a rock series
items.meaningCN: 一套岩石系列的源熔体
items.example: The parental magma was rich in magnesium.

items.meaning: change of melt composition by crystal separation
items.meaningCN: 熔体成分因晶体分离而改变
items.example: Magmatic differentiation produces different rock types.
items.exampleCN: 岩浆分异产生不同的岩石类型。

items.example: Basaltic magma feeds quiet lava flows.
items.exampleCN: 玄武质岩浆供给平静的熔岩流。

definition_zh: 贸易逆差；贸易赤字；进口大于出口的差额
definition_en: the amount by which a country's imports of goods exceed its exports in a given period
core_image: 一架天平，进口一侧的砝码堆得更高，出口一侧翘起，秤杆上标出一个负数
scene: 经济部门的简报会上，分析员把全年进口额与出口额相减，得出一个需要向公众解释的负差额。 The report showed a trade deficit for the third year in a row.
sceneCN: 这里指「进口超过出口的差额」，对应第 1 个义项：一定时期内进口总值大于出口总值的部分；句意为报告显示该国连续第三年出现贸易逆差。画面要点：简报屏幕、两条柱状数据、天平、负号标记。

pos.zh: 贸易逆差；贸易赤字（可数，复数 trade deficits）

derivatives.zh: 赤字；缺额（trade deficit 的核心名词，指收支中短少的部分）
不足的；有缺陷的（同出拉丁 deficere「缺少」，语义偏向质量或数量不够）
缺乏；缺陷（deficient 加名词后缀，指不足的状态）
不足地（deficient 加副词后缀，指以不足的方式）
贸易；交易（短语的前半，源自古英语与低地德语中表示「路径、往来」的词）

senses.title: Imports exceeding exports
senses.definition: the amount by which the value of a country's imports exceeds the value of its exports in a period
senses.definitionCN: 一定时期内一国进口总值超过出口总值的部分
senses.example: The report showed a trade deficit for the third year in a row.
senses.exampleCN: 报告显示该国连续第三年出现贸易逆差。
senses.why: Latin deficit means 'it is lacking', so the phrase names a gap: more value enters as goods than leaves as goods.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁 deficit 意为「它缺了」，因此这个短语指一道缺口：以货物形式进来的价值多于出去的价值。

senses.title: The size of the gap
senses.definition: the measured size of the shortfall, usually in money terms
senses.definitionCN: 这一短少部分的计量规模，通常以货币计
senses.example: The trade deficit reached forty billion dollars.
senses.exampleCN: 贸易逆差达到四百亿美元。
senses.why: Deficit is countable, so the phrase can name a figure that rises, falls or sets a record.
senses.whyCN: deficit 可数，因此这个短语能指一个会上升、下降或创纪录的数字。

senses.title: A bilateral deficit with one partner
senses.titleCN: 与某一贸易伙伴的双边逆差
senses.definition: the excess of imports from one country over exports to that same country
senses.definitionCN: 从某一国进口超过向该国出口的部分
senses.example: The trade deficit with that partner dominated the talks.
senses.exampleCN: 与那个伙伴的贸易逆差主导了会谈。
senses.why: Trade is counted partner by partner, so the same gap can be attributed to a single relationship.
senses.whyCN: 贸易按伙伴逐一对计，因此同一道缺口可以归属于单一关系。

senses.title: The deficit in goods alone
senses.definition: the shortfall measured on goods only, leaving services aside
senses.definitionCN: 只按货物计算、把服务放在一边的差额
senses.example: The goods trade deficit is larger than the overall figure.
senses.exampleCN: 货物贸易逆差大于总体数字。
senses.why: Statistical systems separate goods from services, so the phrase is often qualified to show which ledger is meant.
senses.whyCN: 统计体系把货物与服务分开，因此这个短语常被限定，以说明看的是哪一本账。

senses.title: The deficit as a share of the economy
senses.titleCN: 以占经济总量的比例表示的逆差
senses.definition: the deficit expressed as a percentage of gross domestic product
senses.definitionCN: 以国内生产总值的百分比表示的逆差
senses.example: The trade deficit equals three percent of output.
senses.exampleCN: 贸易逆差相当于产出的百分之三。
senses.why: A raw number means little without scale, so economists divide it by the size of the economy.
senses.whyCN: 没有尺度，裸数字意义不大，因此经济学家用经济规模来除它。

senses.title: The deficit and its financing
senses.definition: the deficit viewed together with the capital inflows that fund it
senses.definitionCN: 与为其提供资金的资本流入一并看待的逆差
senses.example: A trade deficit must be matched by capital inflow.
senses.exampleCN: 贸易逆差必须由资本流入来对应。
senses.why: Goods flowing in are paid for by money or claims flowing out, so the gap always has a financial twin.
senses.whyCN: 货物流入要由资金或债权流出支付，因此这道缺口总有一个金融上的孪生面。

senses.title: The deficit as a political argument
senses.definition: the deficit used in debate as evidence of unfair trade or weak industry
senses.definitionCN: 在争论中被用作不公平贸易或产业疲弱之证据的逆差
senses.example: Politicians cite the trade deficit when arguing for tariffs.
senses.exampleCN: 政客主张加征关税时援引贸易逆差。
senses.why: A single number is easy to campaign with, so the phrase acquired a rhetorical life beyond accounting.
senses.whyCN: 一个数字便于竞选宣传，因此这个短语获得了超出会计范围的说服力。

senses.title: The deficit narrowing or widening
senses.titleCN: 逆差的收窄或扩大趋势
senses.definition: the direction in which the gap is moving over successive periods
senses.definitionCN: 这道缺口在连续各期中的变化方向
senses.example: A weaker currency helped narrow the trade deficit.
senses.exampleCN: 货币走弱帮助收窄了贸易逆差。
senses.why: Because the phrase names a flow over time, it is naturally described as widening, narrowing or reversing.
senses.whyCN: 因为这个短语指一段时间内的流量，自然会有扩大、收窄或反转等说法。

intro.en: Trade deficit joins trade, a word of path and exchange, with deficit, a Latin verb form meaning 'it is lacking'. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: trade deficit 把表示「路径与往来」的 trade，与拉丁动词形式 deficit「它缺了」组合起来。年代均为约数。

items.en: Trade probably came into English from Middle Low German or Dutch, where it meant a track or course, and English widened it to commerce and exchange.
items.cn: trade 很可能经中古低地德语或荷兰语进入英语，原指路径或行程，英语把它扩展到商业往来。

items.en: Deficere meant 'to fail, run short, be lacking', built on de- 'away' and facere 'to do or make'.
items.cn: deficere 意为「失败、短缺、缺少」，由 de-「离开」与 facere「做、造」构成。

items.en: Deficit is the third person singular present of deficere, 'it is lacking'; accountants took the verb form and used it as a noun.
items.cn: deficit 是 deficere 的第三人称单数现在时，意为「它缺了」；会计把这个动词形式借来当名词用。

items.en: English adopted deficit in the eighteenth century for a shortfall in accounts, especially public accounts.
items.cn: 英语在 18 世纪吸收 deficit，指账目中的短少，尤指公共账目。

items.en: As trade statistics became routine, the phrase trade deficit fixed the goods gap beside the older budget deficit.
items.cn: 随着贸易统计常规化，trade deficit 这一说法把货物缺口与较早的预算赤字区分开来。

note.en: The first group shares the lacking root or looks close to it; the second group names related gaps that are measured differently.
note.cn: 第一组共享「缺少」词根或与之外形相近；第二组是算法不同的相关缺口。

entries.definition: Any amount by which money falls short; alone it usually means a budget deficit, while trade deficit specifies the goods account.
entries.definitionCN: 任何资金短少的数额；单独使用时通常指预算赤字，而 trade deficit 特指货物账目。

entries.definition: Lacking something needed, often a nutrient or a quality; it describes a condition, not an account.
entries.definitionCN: 缺少所需之物，常指营养或品质；它描述状态，不描述账目。

entries.definition: A shortage or a flaw, such as a vitamin deficiency; it is not a trade measure.
entries.definitionCN: 短缺或缺陷，如维生素缺乏；它不是贸易指标。

entries.definition: Exports exceeding imports; the same ledger with the sign reversed.
entries.definitionCN: 出口超过进口；同一本账，符号相反。

entries.definition: An informal word for the same shortfall; it stresses the hole rather than the accounting term.
entries.definitionCN: 同一短少的非正式说法；它强调那个窟窿，而不是会计术语。

entries.definition: A shortfall covering goods, services and income flows; a trade deficit is only the goods part.
entries.definitionCN: 涵盖货物、服务与收入流的短少；贸易逆差只是其中的货物部分。

entries.definition: The gap between public spending and revenue; it concerns the state's purse, not the goods ledger.
entries.definitionCN: 公共支出与收入之间的缺口；它关乎国库，而非货物账目。

entries.definition: Any mismatch between two sides; it can describe trade without saying which side is larger.
entries.definitionCN: 两侧任何不匹配；它可以描述贸易，却不说哪一侧更大。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real Latin verb form, the real trade word and real statistical phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的拉丁动词形式、真实的贸易词与真实统计搭配。

normal.en: Deficit is literally 'it is lacking', so a trade deficit is the ledger saying something is short.
normal.cn: deficit 字面是「它缺了」，因此贸易逆差就是账本在说短了一截。

normal.en: The opposite phrase is trade surplus, the same ledger with the other sign.
normal.cn: 反义说法是 trade surplus，同一本账的另一符号。

normal.en: Fixed phrases show the uses: run a trade deficit, widen the deficit, a record deficit.
normal.cn: 固定搭配显示用法：出现逆差、扩大逆差、创纪录逆差。

normal.en: Deficit is countable, so it takes a, rises, falls and reaches a figure.
normal.cn: deficit 可数，因此能带冠词，能上升、下降、达到某个数字。

normal.en: Keep the three ledgers apart: goods, current account and government budget.
normal.cn: 要把三本账分开：货物账、经常账户账与政府预算账。

abstract.en: Picture a scale where the import pan sinks and the export pan rises, and a minus sign hangs on the beam.
abstract.cn: 想象一架天平，进口那端下沉，出口那端翘起，横梁上挂着一个负号。

abstract.en: Picture a door where more parcels come in than go out, and the hallway slowly fills.
abstract.cn: 想象一道门，进来的包裹比出去的多，走廊慢慢被堆满。

abstract.en: Picture a bank statement where the outflow column is longer than the inflow column.
abstract.cn: 想象一份银行对账单，支出栏比收入栏长。

examples.en: The country has run a trade deficit since the tariff cuts.
examples.cn: 自削减关税以来，该国一直处于贸易逆差。

examples.en: A falling currency can shrink the trade deficit over time.
examples.cn: 货币贬值可以逐渐缩小贸易逆差。

examples.en: The bilateral trade deficit with that partner hit a new high.
examples.cn: 与该伙伴的双边贸易逆差创下新高。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「进口多、出口少，账上缺一块」——deficit 是「缺」，trade 是贸易 → 贸易逆差

root: trade 源自古英语与中古低地德语中表示「路径、往来」的词；deficit 是拉丁 deficere「缺少」的第三人称单数形式，字面为「它缺了」。合指进口大于出口的差额。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all describe one gap: the excess of imports over exports, its size, its bilateral form, its goods-only measure, its share of output, its financing, its political use and its direction over time.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项描述同一道缺口：进口超过出口的部分、其数额、其双边形式、仅计货物的算法、其占产出的比例、其资金来源、其政治用途，以及其随时间的走向。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a scale with the import pan heavier and a minus sign on the beam.
core.cn: 核心意象：一架天平，进口那端更重，横梁上有个负号。

branches.en: BASE GAP: the ledger records more incoming than outgoing value.
branches.cn: 基础缺口：账上记的流入价值多于流出价值。

branches.en: MEASURE AND TREND: the gap has a size and a direction.
branches.cn: 数额与趋势：这道缺口有大小，也有走向。

branches.en: ONE PARTNER: the same gap can be attributed to a single relationship.
branches.cn: 单一伙伴：同一缺口可归属于一段双边关系。

branches.en: SCOPE AND SCALE: goods alone, or the gap as a share of output.
branches.cn: 范围与尺度：或只计货物，或折算为产出的比例。

branches.en: MONEY AND POLITICS: the gap is financed by inflows and argued over in public.
branches.cn: 金钱与政治：缺口由流入资金对应，也在公共争论中被援引。

intro.en: Trade deficit is a phrase of two free words, one about exchange and one a Latin verb form frozen as a noun.
intro.cn: trade deficit 由两个自由词构成，一个讲往来，一个是凝固成名词的拉丁动词形式。

latinIntro.en: Latin deficere 'to be lacking' gives deficit, deficient and deficiency; trade has a Germanic origin and gives trading, trader and trademark.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 deficere「缺少」衍生 deficit、deficient 与 deficiency；trade 源自日耳曼语，衍生 trading、trader 与 trademark。

items.example: The prefix marks a falling away from fullness.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀标出从充盈状态退开。

items.example: The root underlies many verbs of making.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根构成许多表示「做」的动词。

items.example: The account shows a deficit.
The soil is deficient in nitrogen.
A vitamin deficiency caused the illness.
items.exampleCN: 维生素缺乏导致了这场病。

items.example: Trade between the ports grew.
items.exampleCN: 港口之间的贸易增长了。

items.meaning: the activity of buying and selling
items.example: Trading was heavy that morning.
A trader bought the whole lot.
items.exampleCN: 一位交易者买下了整批货。

items.example: The surplus was reinvested.
They ran a trade deficit.

latinEntries.structure: deficit (third person singular present of deficere)

definition_zh: 研究结构如何安全承受荷载、并把力从一点传到另一点的工程分支
definition_en: the branch of engineering that studies how structures carry loads safely and pass force from one point to another
core_image: 钢梁上的砝码一级级加重，梁身微微下弯，力沿着梁腹传到两端支座，支座再把力压进地面
scene: 台风过后，塔身轻微倾斜却没有倒塌，检查人员沿基座查看支撑构件。 Good structural engineering kept the tower standing through the typhoon.
sceneCN: 这里指研究结构承重与传力的工程分支（第 1 个义项：研究结构如何安全承受荷载并把力从一点传到另一点的工程分支）；句意：良好的结构工程让这座塔在台风中屹立不倒。

derivatives.zh: 由拉丁语「建造」加表示结果的名词词尾构成，义为「结构」
由「结构」加形容词词尾构成，义为「结构的」
由「结构的」加副词词尾构成，义为「结构上」
由拉丁语「一起建造」构成，义为「建造」
由「建造」加表示结果的名词词尾构成，义为「建造、施工」
由拉丁语「在内建造」构成，义为「指导、教导」
由拉丁语「巧思」经法语进入英语，义为「工程师」

senses.title: The branch that checks load paths
senses.definition: the branch of engineering that analyses how loads travel through a structure and whether every member can carry them
senses.definitionCN: 分析荷载如何在结构中传递、每个构件能否承担的分析分支
senses.example: Structural engineering decides which member carries which load.
senses.exampleCN: 结构工程决定哪个构件承担哪一份荷载。
senses.why: Structural marks the frame, engineering marks the profession, so the phrase names the branch that reads the frame.
senses.whyCN: 「结构的」标出框架，「工程」标出专业，因此这个词组指解读框架的分支。

senses.title: Loads and forces
senses.definition: the calculation of dead, live, wind and seismic loads and the forces they produce
senses.definitionCN: 计算恒载、活载、风载与地震荷载及其产生的内力
senses.example: Structural engineering added the wind load that the first design ignored.
senses.exampleCN: 结构工程补上了初版设计忽略的风荷载。
senses.why: Before a member can be sized, its loads must be known, so load study is the branch's first task.
senses.whyCN: 构件定尺寸之前必须先知道荷载，因此荷载研究是该分支的首要任务。

senses.title: Steel design
senses.definition: the sizing and connection of steel beams, columns and frames
senses.definitionCN: 钢梁、钢柱与钢框架的选型与连接设计
senses.example: Structural engineering chose a steel frame for the long span.
senses.exampleCN: 结构工程为这一大跨度选择了钢框架。
senses.why: Steel carries tension well, so the branch uses it where spans must be light and long.
senses.whyCN: 钢材抗拉性能好，该分支便把它用在需要轻而长的跨度处。

senses.title: Concrete structures
senses.definition: the design of reinforced concrete beams, slabs and columns
senses.definitionCN: 钢筋混凝土梁、板与柱的设计
senses.example: Structural engineering placed the reinforcement where tension appears.
senses.exampleCN: 结构工程把钢筋放在出现拉力的位置。
senses.why: Concrete is strong in compression but weak in tension, so the branch adds steel where it is pulled.
senses.whyCN: 混凝土抗压好而抗拉弱，该分支便在受拉处加钢筋。

senses.title: Seismic design
senses.definition: the detailing of structures so that they bend without collapsing during an earthquake
senses.definitionCN: 细部设计使结构在地震中变形而不倒塌
senses.example: Structural engineering let the frame sway rather than break.
senses.exampleCN: 结构工程让框架摇摆而不是断裂。
senses.why: A structure can survive a quake by yielding in planned places, and that planning is the branch's job.
senses.whyCN: 结构可在地震中通过有计划的部位屈服而存活，这种规划正是该分支的工作。

senses.title: Strengthening existing structures
senses.definition: the assessment and retrofit of old buildings that must carry new loads
senses.definitionCN: 评估并改造需要承担新荷载的旧建筑
senses.example: Structural engineering strengthened the floor before the new machines arrived.
senses.exampleCN: 结构工程在新机器运来之前加固了楼板。
senses.why: Old frames often outlive their original use, so the branch also works backwards on what already stands.
senses.whyCN: 旧框架常比原用途活得更久，因此该分支也反过来处理已建成的东西。

senses.title: Bridge structures
senses.definition: the design of bridge decks, girders, arches and cables
senses.definitionCN: 桥面、主梁、拱与索的设计
senses.example: Structural engineering tuned the cable forces of the new footbridge.
senses.exampleCN: 结构工程调校了新人行桥的索力。
senses.why: A bridge is a frame whose whole purpose is to span, so it is a favourite object of the branch.
senses.whyCN: 桥梁是专为跨越而设的框架，因此是该分支最常处理的对象。

senses.title: The degree and the consultant
senses.definition: the university training and the professional practice that certify structural engineers
senses.definitionCN: 培养并认证结构工程师的大学训练与专业实务
senses.example: He took structural engineering after his first degree in civil works.
senses.exampleCN: 他在取得土木工程本科学位后攻读结构工程。
senses.why: The branch has its own advanced training and its own consultants, so the phrase also names a career.
senses.whyCN: 该分支有自己的进阶训练与顾问，因此这个词组也指一种职业。

intro.en: Structural engineering joins a Latin noun for building with the profession word from ingenium; it names the branch that asks whether a frame can stand.
intro.cn: 「结构工程」把拉丁语中表示「建造」的名词，与源自「巧思」的专业词组合；它命名的是追问框架能否站住的分支。

items.en: Struere meant to build, to pile up or to arrange in layers; it is the direct Latin source, while its own earlier root is a reconstruction often, but not certainly, linked to a spreading root.
items.cn: 这个拉丁语动词指建造、堆叠或分层排列；它是本词的直接拉丁语来源，其更早词根属重构性质，常被联结到表示「铺展」的词根，但并无确证。

items.en: Structura named the act and result of building, and English took it as structure for both the frame and its arrangement.
items.cn: 这个拉丁语名词指建造的行为与结果，英语以「结构」接收它，既指框架也指其安排方式。

items.en: The adjective structural appeared in the nineteenth century for what belongs to a frame or to the arrangement of parts.
items.cn: 「结构的」这一形容词在十九世纪出现，指属于框架或部件安排方式的。

items.en: Ingenium meant natural ability; French engin, a clever device, produced English engineer.
items.cn: 这个拉丁语名词指天赋；法语中指精巧装置的一词产生了英语「工程师」。

items.era: NINETEENTH CENTURY SPLIT · FIRST RECORD DATE UNCERTAIN
items.en: As iron, steel and reinforced concrete made frames calculable, structural work separated from general civil engineering as its own branch; the exact year of first record is uncertain.
items.cn: 随着铁、钢与钢筋混凝土使框架可计算，结构工作从普通土木工程中分离出来，成为独立分支；具体首见年代不确定。

items.en: The phrase now covers load analysis, member design, seismic detailing and the assessment of existing buildings and bridges.
items.cn: 这个词组如今涵盖荷载分析、构件设计、抗震细部与既有建筑及桥梁的评估。

note.en: The first group shares the build root; the second group names nearby design fields and ideas.
note.cn: 第一组共享「建造」词根；第二组是相邻的设计领域与概念。

entries.definition: The frame or arrangement itself; the phrase names the branch that designs it.
entries.definitionCN: 框架或安排本身；词组指设计它的分支。

entries.definition: Of a frame or of parts arranged together; it is the first half of the target.
entries.definitionCN: 框架的、部件安排的；是目标词组的前半。

entries.definition: To build by putting parts together; it shares the root but names the act.
entries.definitionCN: 把部件组合起来建造；共享词根，但指动作。

entries.definition: To build knowledge into someone; the same root with a different prefix.
entries.definitionCN: 把知识建进某人心中；同词根不同前缀。

entries.definition: The wider field that includes structures among roads, water and ground works.
entries.definitionCN: 更宽的领域，结构只是道路、水利与岩土工作之一。

entries.definition: Describing a part that carries weight; an idea inside the branch, not the branch itself.
entries.definitionCN: 描述承担重量的部件；是分支内的概念，而非分支。

entries.definition: The physical study of stress and strain; it supplies the branch's theory.
entries.definitionCN: 研究应力与应变的物理学；为该分支提供理论。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes and real fixed terms, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分与真实固定搭配，而不是编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Structure comes from a Latin verb meaning to build in layers.
normal.cn: 「结构」来自一个表示分层建造的拉丁语动词。

normal.en: The family runs structure, structural, construct, construction, instruct.
normal.cn: 同族词包括结构、结构的、建造、施工、指导。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark it: structural engineering analysis, structural engineering software.
normal.cn: 固定搭配可标记它：结构工程分析、结构工程软件。

normal.en: Its daily question is simple: can this frame carry that load?
normal.cn: 它的日常问题很简单：这个框架能承担那份荷载吗？

normal.en: Its answers are written in steel, concrete, timber and cable.
normal.cn: 它的答案写在钢、混凝土、木材与索上。

abstract.en: Picture a chain of hands where every hand must hold the weight passed to it.
abstract.cn: 想象一串手，每只手都必须接住传过来的重量。

abstract.en: Picture a tree that bends in a storm rather than snapping at the trunk.
abstract.cn: 想象一棵树在风暴中弯曲，而不是在树干处折断。

abstract.en: Picture a bridge that tells the river below exactly where its weight goes.
abstract.cn: 想象一座桥清楚地告诉下方的河，它的重量去了哪里。

examples.en: Structural engineering explains why the balcony needed a second beam.
examples.cn: 结构工程解释了这座阳台为何需要第二根梁。

examples.en: The structural engineering report listed every overloaded joint.
examples.cn: 结构工程报告列出了每个超载节点。

examples.en: She teaches structural engineering to third-year civil students.
examples.cn: 她给三年级土木学生教授结构工程。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「结构」+「工程」——把每一份重量沿框架送到地面

root: 前半源自拉丁语「分层建造」的结果名词，后半源自拉丁语「巧思」经法语的「工程师」；建造一词更早的来源存疑。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one question: where does the weight go? The phrase covers load paths, loads, steel, concrete, earthquakes, repair, bridges and the profession.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项围绕一个问题：重量去哪里？这个词组覆盖传力路径、荷载、钢材、混凝土、地震、加固、桥梁与职业。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a frame bending slightly under a load and passing it along members until the ground takes it.
core.cn: 核心意象：框架在荷载下微微弯曲，把力沿构件逐段传递，直到地面接住它。

branches.en: THE METHOD: finding the load path and calculating the loads that travel along it.
branches.cn: 方法：找出传力路径并计算沿路径传递的荷载。

branches.en: THE STEEL VERSION: light frames for long spans.
branches.cn: 钢材版本：用于大跨度的轻质框架。

branches.en: THE CONCRETE VERSION: mass in compression with steel where tension appears.
branches.cn: 混凝土版本：受压的实体，在受拉处配钢筋。

branches.en: THE RESISTANCE VERSION: planned yielding in earthquakes and strengthening of old frames.
branches.cn: 抗力版本：地震中有计划的屈服，以及旧框架的加固。

branches.en: THE SPANNING AND PROFESSIONAL VERSION: bridges and the certified consultant.
branches.cn: 跨越与职业版本：桥梁与持证顾问。

intro.en: Both halves are Latin-rooted: one from a verb of layered building, one from the word for cleverness behind engineer.
intro.cn: 两半都是拉丁语词根：一半来自分层建造的动词，一半来自「工程师」背后的「巧思」。

latinIntro.en: Latin struere and structura supply the frame half; ingenium supplies the profession half.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的「建造」与「结构」提供框架一半，「巧思」提供专业一半。

definition_zh: 入侵部队；侵略军；登陆编队
definition_en: the whole body of troops, ships and aircraft assembled to carry out an invasion, or any major part of it
core_image: 河口外的锚地，运输船与护航舰排成长列，甲板上停着车辆与箱笼，岸线在雾里只露一道浅灰
scene: 河口外的锚地，运输船与护航舰排成长列，甲板上停着车辆。 The invasion force assembled in the estuary and waited for calm weather.
sceneCN: 这里 invasion force 指「为实施入侵而集结的整支武装力量」（第 1 个义项：入侵部队整体）；句意为入侵部队在河口集结，等待天气转稳。场景物件：运输船、护航舰、甲板车辆、锚地。

pos.zh: 入侵部队；侵略军；登陆编队

senses.title: The whole body assembled to invade
senses.titleCN: 为入侵集结的整支部队
senses.definition: all the troops, ships and aircraft gathered to carry out one invasion
senses.definitionCN: 为执行一次入侵而汇集的所有兵员、舰船与飞机
senses.example: The invasion force assembled in the estuary and waited for calm weather.
senses.exampleCN: 入侵部队在河口集结，等待天气转稳。
senses.why: the phrase joins the name of the act to the name of the body, so it can hold an entire expedition in two words.
senses.whyCN: 这个短语把行为之名与力量之名接在一起，两个词就装下整场远征。

senses.title: The landing troops
senses.definition: the soldiers or marines who are put ashore first, as distinct from the ships that carry them
senses.definitionCN: 最先上岸的士兵或陆战队员，与运送他们的舰船相区别
senses.example: The invasion force came ashore in four waves before the tide turned.
senses.exampleCN: 入侵部队在潮水转向之前分四批上岸。
senses.why: because a landing is the decisive moment, the phrase often narrows to the men on the beaches.
senses.whyCN: 由于登陆是决定性时刻，这个短语常收窄到海滩上的人。

senses.title: The fleet that carries them
senses.definition: the ships and landing craft that move and supply the troops
senses.definitionCN: 运送与补给兵员的舰船与登陆艇
senses.example: The invasion force lay offshore for two days under radio silence.
senses.exampleCN: 入侵舰队在无线电静默下于近海停了两天。
senses.why: naval usage lets the same phrase name the floating half of the expedition, since without it no landing happens.
senses.whyCN: 海军用法让同一短语指远征中漂浮的那一半，因为没有它就没有登陆。

senses.title: The air component
senses.definition: the aircraft and airborne units that support or precede the landing
senses.definitionCN: 支援或先于登陆的飞机与空降部队
senses.example: The invasion force included night bombers and two airborne divisions.
senses.exampleCN: 入侵编队包括夜间轰炸机与两个空降师。
senses.why: twentieth-century warfare made air power part of the body, so the phrase grew a third arm.
senses.whyCN: 20 世纪的战争让空中力量成为这支队伍的一部分，短语由此长出第三条臂膀。

senses.title: The joint command organisation
senses.definition: the headquarters and staff that control the whole operation
senses.definitionCN: 控制整个行动的司令部与参谋机构
senses.example: The invasion force had its own signal company and weather officer.
senses.exampleCN: 入侵部队有自己的通信连与气象军官。
senses.why: staff language treats the command as the force itself, because the body cannot move without it.
senses.whyCN: 参谋语言把指挥机构当作部队本身，因为没有它这具躯体动不了。

senses.title: A named historical expedition
senses.definition: a particular invasion force remembered under a campaign name or a date
senses.definitionCN: 以战役名或年代被记住的某支入侵部队
senses.example: The Norman invasion force carried horses, prefabricated forts and a duke.
senses.exampleCN: 诺曼入侵部队带着马匹、预制堡垒和一位公爵。
senses.why: historians turn one assembly into a proper name, and the phrase becomes a chapter heading.
senses.whyCN: 史家把一次集结变成专名，这个短语于是成了章节标题。

senses.title: A mass arrival, used loosely
senses.definition: any large group whose arrival feels like an occupation
senses.definitionCN: 任何到来时像占领一样的大群人
senses.example: An invasion force of tourists took every table by one o'clock.
senses.exampleCN: 到一点钟，一支由游客组成的入侵部队已占满每张桌子。
senses.why: journalists borrow the military phrase for comic effect, and the exaggeration is the point.
senses.whyCN: 记者借用这个军事短语制造滑稽效果，夸张本身就是要点。

senses.title: A fictional or game army
senses.titleCN: 虚构或推演中的入侵军团
senses.definition: an invading army in a novel, film, wargame or strategy game
senses.definitionCN: 小说、电影、兵棋或策略游戏中的入侵军队
senses.example: The scenario gives each player one invasion force and one winter.
senses.exampleCN: 这个推演给每位玩家一支入侵部队和一个冬天。
senses.why: games and fiction keep the phrase because it instantly supplies a side, a goal and a supply line.
senses.whyCN: 游戏与虚构保留这个短语，因为它立刻提供一方、一个目标与一条补给线。

intro.en: Invasion force is an English phrase joining invasion, from Latin invasio, to force, from Old French force and Latin fortis 'strong'.
intro.cn: invasion force 是英语短语，把 invasion（来自拉丁 invasio）与 force（来自古法语 force、拉丁 fortis「强」）接在一起。

items.en: Invasion is Latin invasio 'a going into, an attack', the noun of invadere, built on in- 'into' and vadere 'to go'.
items.cn: invasion 是拉丁 invasio「进入、攻击」，即 invadere 的名词，由 in-「进入」与 vadere「走」构成。

items.en: Force came through Old French force from Late Latin fortia, a noun of strength built on fortis 'strong'.
items.cn: force 经古法语 force 来自晚期拉丁 fortia，这是由 fortis「强」构成的「力量」名词。

items.en: The phrase settled in the nineteenth and twentieth centuries as staff language for the whole body assembled to seize a coast or a country.
items.cn: 这个短语在 19 与 20 世纪固定为参谋用语，指为夺取海岸或国家而集结的整支部队。

items.en: Because a landing needs ships, aircraft and troops, the phrase can name the whole or any major part, and context decides.
items.cn: 由于登陆需要舰船、飞机与兵员，这个短语可指全体，也可指任一主要部分，由语境决定。

items.en: Journalists also use it for any large hostile-seeming arrival, from insects to tourists.
items.cn: 记者也用它指任何看似敌意的大批到来，从昆虫到游客。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date): the phrase has no single documented coinage, and its earliest military use is dated only approximately.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代）：这个短语没有单一可考的最早造词，其最早军事用例只能约略定年。

note.en: Group one holds compounds built on force; group two holds other names for a body sent to fight abroad.
note.cn: 第一组是以 force 构成的复合词；第二组是派往海外作战之部队的其他名称。

entries.definition: A group assembled for a specific operation; it need not be an invasion and may be small.
entries.definitionCN: 为特定行动组建的队伍；不一定是入侵，规模也可能很小。

entries.definition: A standing branch of a nation's military, not an expedition gathered for one landing.
entries.definitionCN: 国家常设军种，不是为一次登陆而集结的远征。

entries.definition: The present-participle variant describes the body while it acts; the noun phrase names it as a thing.
entries.definitionCN: 现在分词变体描述正在行动的部队；名词短语则把它当作一个事物来命名。

entries.definition: On its own it means strength or an organised body; the compound narrows it to one purpose.
entries.definitionCN: 单独使用时指力量或有组织的队伍；复合后收窄到单一目的。

entries.definition: Troops sent to a distant theatre for a campaign, whether or not they invade.
entries.definitionCN: 派往远方战区的部队，无论是否入侵。

entries.definition: A large fleet, often used historically or rhetorically; it covers ships only.
entries.definitionCN: 庞大的舰队，常用于历史或修辞语境；只涵盖舰船。

entries.definition: A small detachment put ashore for a limited task, much smaller than an invasion force.
entries.definitionCN: 为有限任务上岸的小分队，比入侵部队小得多。

entries.definition: Soldiers stationed to hold a place already taken, the opposite of a body sent to take one.
entries.definitionCN: 驻扎守住已占之地的士兵，与派去攻取的部队正相反。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: a real compound, a real Latin root behind force and real campaign names.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的复合结构、force 背后真实的拉丁词根与真实战役名。

normal.en: invasion + force: the act plus the body that performs it.
normal.cn: invasion + force：行为加上执行它的那具躯体。

normal.en: force goes back to fortis 'strong', which also gives fort, fortify and effort.
normal.cn: force 上承 fortis「强」，还给出 fort、fortify、effort。

normal.en: The phrase can name the troops, the ships, the aircraft or the command, and context decides.
normal.cn: 这个短语可指兵员、舰船、飞机或指挥机构，由语境决定。

normal.en: History supplies the example: the Norman invasion force of 1066.
normal.cn: 历史提供例子：一〇六六年的诺曼入侵部队。

normal.en: Modern loose use turns tourists into an invasion force, with the joke carried by the exaggeration.
normal.cn: 现代宽松用法把游客变成入侵部队，笑点由夸张承担。

examples.cn: 这支入侵部队需要平静的水面，胜过需要更多人手。

examples.en: The invasion force lost two supply ships before it reached the coast.
examples.cn: 入侵部队在抵达海岸前损失了两艘补给船。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses divide one expedition into its parts: the whole body, the landing troops, the fleet, the aircraft, the command, a named historical case, a joking crowd and a game army.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项把同一支远征拆成几部分：全体、登陆兵员、舰队、航空部分、指挥机构、有专名的历史个案、戏谑的人潮与游戏中的军团。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: transports and escorts in a long line at anchor, vehicles on deck, a grey coast in fog.
core.cn: 核心意象：运输船与护航舰在锚地排成长列，甲板上停着车辆，雾中只有一道灰色的海岸。

branches.en: WHOLE AND HEAD: the assembled expedition and its headquarters are named by the same phrase because neither moves without the other.
branches.cn: 全体与首脑：整支远征与其司令部用同一短语命名，因为缺一皆不能动。

branches.en: MEN AND SHIPS: the troops on the beach and the fleet offshore are the two halves of one landing.
branches.cn: 人与船：海滩上的兵员与近海的舰队，是一次登陆的两半。

branches.en: AIR: twentieth-century warfare added a third arm to the body.
branches.cn: 空中：20 世纪的战争给这具躯体加上第三条臂膀。

branches.en: HISTORY: one assembly becomes a proper name and a chapter heading.
branches.cn: 历史：一次集结变成专名与章节标题。

branches.en: BORROWED BODIES: tourists and game armies borrow the phrase, one for a joke and one for a scenario.
branches.cn: 借用的躯体：游客与游戏军团都借用这个短语，一为玩笑，一为推演。

intro.en: Invasion force is a two-word English phrase whose halves come from Latin and French, and each half has its own family.
intro.cn: invasion force 是一个两词英语短语，两半分别来自拉丁与法语，各自都有词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin vadere 'to go' stands behind invasion, and Latin fortis 'strong' stands behind force through Late Latin fortia and Old French.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 vadere「走」是 invasion 的底；拉丁 fortis「强」经晚期拉丁 fortia 与古法语成为 force 的底。

items.example: The root supplies motion in invasion.

items.example: The suffix makes invasion an event noun.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把 invasion 变成事件名词。

items.example: The root supplies strength in force and fortify.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根为 force 与 fortify 提供「强」。
